entries.title: Add 12h/24h Timeline Format Toggle in Standard Resource Scheduler
entries.description:
What's new

  • 12h/24h Time Format Option Added to the Resource Scheduler
  • Users can now switch between 12-hour and 24-hour time formats directly from the three-dot menu in the Resource Scheduler.


How it works

  • Open the three-dot menu in the Resource Scheduler and select the preferred time format.
  • In 12-hour format, hour labels are displayed from 12 AM–11 PM.
  • In 24-hour format, hour labels are displayed from 00–23.
  • The selected time format remains consistent when switching between scheduler views or refreshing the page.


Benefit

  • This gives users greater flexibility to view the Resource Scheduler in their preferred time format, making scheduling and interpreting time slots easier and more intuitive.

entries.title: Resource Scheduler keeps reservation description and priority on edit
entries.description:
What's new

  • When an existing reservation is opened for editing in Resource Scheduler, the Description field now shows the saved text and the Priority selector now shows the current priority.

How it works

  • In the reservation editor, Description loads the value already stored on the reservation instead of opening empty.
  • In the same editor, Priority highlights the reservation's current Low, Medium, or High value.
  • Users can change either value and save the reservation, and the updated selection is kept when the reservation is reopened.

Benefit

  • Users can review and update existing reservations without having to remember or re-enter values that were already set.

entries.title: PDF and video annotations are now supported
entries.description:
What's new

  • Annotations can now be added to PDF files and videos. This makes it possible to review content with page-level or frame-level feedback instead of relying on external notes.

How it works

  • Annotation support is available in the Annotations area and applies to uploaded PDF and video files. For PDFs, each page can be reviewed individually and its approval status is stored separately. The approval flow now supports multiple states within the same file so approved and rejected pages can coexist in one document.

Benefit

  • Reviewers can leave feedback directly on the content they are checking, which makes multi-page reviews easier to follow and reduces confusion when a single file contains mixed results.


More details here: https://documentation.skillsworkflow.com/docs/customization/annotations

entries.title: Filter Typologies by Rate Card in Budget Quotations
entries.description:
What’s new

  • A new setting has been added to restrict typologies displayed in Estimate rate cards to only those configured in the client’s active Rate Table. This prevents irrelevant typologies from appearing and reduces the risk of incorrect selections.

How it works

  • A new FilterTypologyGroupsByRateCard setting is available at the Estimate Job Type level. When enabled and a Rate Card is defined for the Estimate, only the typologies present in that Rate Card Table will be displayed in the Estimate quotation view.
  • Typologies not included in the Rate Card are hidden, ensuring that users only select valid, billable typologies.

Benefit

  • This feature streamlines the budgeting process, improves data consistency, and reduces the likelihood of errors or pricing inconsistencies by guiding users to only select typologies with valid rates.

entries.title: Discounts Apply to Totals in Estimate Resources
entries.description:
What’s new

  • A new enhancement has been added to the Resources section of Estimate Quotes: applying a Discount % or fixed Discount now affects the Total Sell Value and Total Income.
  • Previously, discounts could be entered but were not applied to totals.

How it works

  • When a discount is entered for a resource, the system recalculates the Unit Price Income.
  • The Total Sell Value and Total Income fields now update automatically to reflect the applied discount.

Benefit

  • This enhancement allows users to apply discounts directly to resources in Estimate Quotes and see accurate totals, improving pricing transparency and making budget planning more precise.

entries.title: Automatic Transfer of Contracted Hours from Estimate to Job
entries.description:
What’s New

  • A new workflow action has been introduced to ensure that the planned hours from budget deliverables are correctly transferred to the corresponding Jobs, just like it already happens with Projects. Two new actions are now available:
    • CreateJobPlannedHoursFromEstimateItemDetails
    • DeleteJobPlannedHoursFromEstimateItemDetails.

How It Works

  • When the CreateJobPlannedHoursFromEstimateItemDetails action is configured in the Estimate workflow, the planned hours defined in the estimate deliverables are automatically sent to the associated Job.
  • If needed, the DeleteJobPlannedHoursFromEstimateItemDetails action can be used to remove this synchronization.
  • These actions can be configured at any workflow transition where it is necessary to update the Job planning based on the Estimate. The process runs automatically and does not interfere with the existing planned hours management flow.

Benefit

  • This feature ensures full alignment between Estimate and Jobs, maintaining data consistency and eliminating manual updates — while preserving control over planned hours within the defined workflow.

entries.title: Editable Unit Income Field in Estimate Resources Section
entries.description:
What’s New

  • The Unit Income field in the Resources section of the Estimate is now editable, allowing users to directly adjust the value being sold to the client without relying solely on discount fields.

How It Works

  • Users can now manually edit the Unit Income value in the Resources grid. When this value is changed, the system automatically recalculates and updates the Discount and Discount % fields to reflect the difference between the Unit Cost and the Unit Income.
  • Conversely, when users edit the Discount or Discount %, the Unit Income will adjust accordingly, while the Cost Total remains unaffected.

Benefit

  • This enhancement gives users greater flexibility and control over pricing during the budgeting process, simplifying adjustments and ensuring that discounts and income values remain consistent and transparent.

entries.title: Visual Indication for Focused Cell in Editable Grids
entries.description:
What’s new

  • A visual indicator has been added to highlight the currently focused cell in grids with inline editing, improving navigation and editing accuracy.

How it works

  • When inline editing is enabled, the focused cell is now highlighted with a light border or background, making it visible without being overly emphasized.
  • Users can see which cell is active while editing or navigating with the keyboard.
  • The indicator updates as the user moves between cells using keyboard arrows or mouse selection.

Benefit

  • This feature improves usability in editable grids, reducing errors and making it easier for users to track their current position while editing data inline.

entries.title: Timesheets Now Respect Correct Local Date in Scheduler
entries.description:
What’s new

  • A fix has been implemented to ensure that timesheets created from the Scheduler or other workspaces are now correctly recorded on the intended day, resolving issues caused by timezone misalignment.

How it works

  • Previously, when confirming hours in the Scheduler, timesheets were occasionally recorded on the previous day instead of the selected day. This occurred due to incorrect conversion from UTC to local time. With the fix, all timesheet entries now correctly reflect the local date, whether created from the Scheduler workspace or Timesheet Scheduler respecting daily workloads in any other workspace.

Benefit

  • This correction ensures accurate tracking of hours and prevents confusion or errors caused by timesheets being assigned to the wrong date, improving reliability and trust in the system’s time reporting.

entries.title: Enhancements to the Job Feed – Improved Filtering, Mentions, and File Handling
entries.description:
What’s new

  • The Job Feed has been enhanced to provide a more complete and reliable collaboration experience. Following the implementation of "Enable Filtering by Stages in Feed Section", several improvements and fixes have been made to ensure smoother interaction, better traceability, and more accurate filtering.

How it works

  • The feed has been refined to address previously identified issues:
    • Mentions are now fully functional, allowing users to tag teammates seamlessly.
    • Search is now case-sensitive, improving precision in finding relevant posts.
    • End date changes are now captured correctly, regardless of whether they’re made through the feed icon or directly within the feed.
    • The “Edited” filter now displays edits made both to main posts and to replies.
    • Images dragged directly into posts are now automatically attached to the Files section, ensuring all files remain properly stored and accessible.

Benefit

  • These updates make the Job Feed more consistent, interactive, and efficient for daily collaboration. Users can now easily track changes, tag colleagues, and manage attachments — all within a more reliable and structured workspace.

entries.title: Display All Default Team Users in Job Creation Popup
entries.description:
What’s new

  • The Job creation popup has been updated to display all users configured in the default teams, removing the previous limitation that only showed up to 20 users.

How it works

  • Previously, when creating a new Job, the popup would only show the first 20 users in a default team, even if more users were configured in that department. After job creation, all users appeared correctly in the team, but the incomplete display caused confusion.

With this update, the popup now displays all users assigned to the default teams, providing full visibility during the creation process.

Benefit

  • This enhancement improves clarity and usability by ensuring that users can see the full team at the moment of Job creation, preventing misunderstandings and reducing unnecessary support requests related to perceived configuration issues.

entries.title: Only Active Rate Cards Suggested When Creating Estimates
entries.description:
What’s new

  • The logic for suggesting client rate cards during estimate creation has been improved to ensure that only active rate tables are automatically suggested.

How it works

  • Previously, when creating a new estimate, the system could suggest a client rate card even if it was inactive, which could lead to errors or outdated values being applied. With this update, the system now only suggests active rate cards. If no active rate card is available, the field will remain empty, requiring the user to select the appropriate rate card manually.

Benefit

  • This adjustment prevents the use of outdated or inactive rate cards, ensuring more accurate and reliable budgeting data while giving users full control when no valid rate card exists.

entries.title: User Color Coding in My Scheduler
entries.description:
What’s new

  • A new User Color Coding option has been added to make it easier to visually differentiate between users in the My Scheduler workspace. Each user can now be assigned a unique color, which will be displayed across their assignments in the weekly agenda view.

How it works

  • A new Color field is now available in the User Profile configuration. Administrators can assign a distinct color to each user, similar to how colors are already defined for Job Types. When multiple users are selected in the My Scheduler workspace, their assignments will be displayed using their designated color, allowing for clear visual identification.

Benefit

  • This enhancement improves clarity and usability in team scheduling by making it immediately visible which tasks belong to which user. It reduces confusion, enhances coordination, and brings the same intuitive color-coded visibility already available in platforms like TeamUp.

entries.title: Removed executors no longer re-added when task end date is changed via schedule
entries.description:
What’s new

  • A fix has been implemented to prevent previously removed executors from being automatically re-added to a task when the End Date is changed through the Resources > Schedule view.

How it works

  • Previously, when a user who had workloads assigned to a task was removed as executor, extending the task’s End Date through the schedule view caused that user to be automatically reassigned. Now, the system ensures that only currently active executors remain assigned when a task date is adjusted. Removed users will no longer be re-added, even if workloads were previously defined.

Benefit

  • This fix ensures better control over task ownership and prevents unintended workload or assignment reactivation, resulting in cleaner and more accurate task management across the scheduling module.

entries.title: Display current month’s Actual Hours in Project Planned Hours module
entries.description:
What’s new

  • The Project Planned Hours module has been improved to display the current month’s Actual Hours, even if the month has not yet ended.

How it works

  • Previously, the Actual Hours column only showed data for completed months, excluding the ongoing month. With this update, the system now includes the current month’s recorded timesheet hours in the Actual Hours view. Corresponding totals in Actual, Forecast, and Actual Totals are also updated to reflect this behavior.

Benefit

  • This enhancement provides project managers with a more accurate and up-to-date overview of project performance, allowing better tracking and forecasting of hours throughout the current month.

entries.title: Prevent duplicate entries when importing Rate Cards
entries.description:
What’s new

  • The rate card import process has been enhanced to prevent the creation of duplicate lines when the same Company – Department – Typology Group – Market combination already exists.

How it works

  • Previously, when importing rate cards, the system would create duplicate entries if identical combinations were found, unlike the manual creation process, which correctly displayed an error. With this update, during import, if an existing line with the same combination is detected, the system will update the existing record instead of creating a new one.

Benefit

  • This improvement ensures data consistency and prevents unnecessary duplication in rate card records, resulting in cleaner data management and a more efficient import process.

entries.title: Implementation of Hour Bank
entries.description:
What’s new

  • A new Hour Bank feature has been introduced, creating a synergy between the Timesheets and Leaves modules. This allows administrators to define a specific Leave Type (e.g., Hour Bank) where the balance is automatically updated based on the number of extra hours allocated (hours above the minimum defined for the user).

How it works

  • Administrators can configure a Leave Type to function as an Hour Bank.
  • When users log hours above their minimum, those hours are added to the Hour Bank balance.
  • Users are required to provide a reason for all extra hours.
  • In the Scheduler, totals now display the Hour Bank leave type with respective hours per day.
  • In Approval, the grid shows totals with the Hour Bank leave type per user group. Days with exceeding hours are also visually highlighted.
  • When an approver approves hours, the system automatically updates the Hour Bank leave type balance according to the approved extra hours.
  • The configuration must be done at multiple levels, including Leaves, Approval, and Timesheet entries. To activate the feature, it should be requested and configured with the assistance of the consulting team.

Benefit

This feature provides a streamlined and transparent way to manage overtime by directly linking it to a leave balance. It reduces manual adjustments, ensures compliance, and gives both employees and managers clearer visibility into the accumulation and usage of extra hours.

entries.title: Configurable Mandatory Fields in Billing Client Creation
entries.description:
What’s new

  • Previously, when creating a Billing Client, only the fields Name and Company were required. However, since not all clients operate the same way, there was a need to enforce additional fields (e.g., TaxPayerNumber) as mandatory during creation.

How it works

  • Through the creation parameters, it is now possible to define which available fields must be mandatory when creating a billing client.
  • For example, administrators can configure the system so that fields like TaxPayerNumber (or others) are required at creation.
  • This ensures flexibility to adapt the billing client setup to different business or regulatory needs.

Benefit

This enhancement gives organizations more control and consistency over billing client data by ensuring that all required information is collected during creation, reducing errors and improving compliance.

entries.title: Default Job Completion Time Based on Company Workday End
entries.description:
What’s new

  • A new feature allows the default completion time for a job to be automatically set according to the company’s workday end time. By default, this is set to 6:00 PM, but users can adjust it as needed when creating or editing a job.

How it works

  • A new setting called UseWorkdayEndTimeInJobAgreedDate is available in the Company configuration.
  • If enabled, the Job Agreed Date will inherit the hours and minutes from the company’s WorkdayEndTime defined in the Configuration.
  • Users can still manually adjust the time for individual jobs if required.

Benefit

This feature ensures consistency across jobs by defaulting the completion time to the company’s standard end-of-day, while still allowing flexibility for manual adjustments, improving scheduling efficiency and reducing errors.

entries.title: Support for Creating Ziflow Proofs Directly from Box Files
entries.description:
What’s new

  • The integration between Skills, Box, and Ziflow has been improved to make the proofing process more efficient. It is now possible to select files stored in Box directly from the Proofing workspace and create proofs in Ziflow without the need for manual downloads and uploads.

How it works

  • A new option allows users to create a proof in Ziflow directly from Box files.
  • When creating the proof, the system automatically sends the related Job information to Ziflow, including Client, Project, and Job details.
  • From the Proofing workspace, users can now select files saved in Box, create the proof, and manage the entire approval process in one streamlined flow.
  • This functionality is supported by an automation that enables the integration between Skills and Ziflow. To make it available, it must be requested and configured with the support team.

Benefit

  • This enhancement eliminates the need for manual file handling, reducing errors and saving time. By managing proof creation and approvals directly from Box within Skills, users can streamline workflows and achieve greater efficiency.

entries.title: Expense Order Field for Improved Integration with External Systems
entries.description:
What’s new

  • An adjustment has been made to Expenses to improve integration with external systems such as Primavera. A new Order field has been introduced, allowing the sending order in Skills to match the order in connected systems.

How it works

  • A configurable Order field is now available for expense items.
  • To make it available, the field must be added via configuration in the Document Member workspace.
  • If assistance is needed, please contact the consulting team.
  • Once configured, the field allows defining a clear order for expenses, ensuring consistent visibility between Skills and third-party systems (e.g., Primavera).

Benefit

This improvement ensures greater reliability and consistency in integrations, preventing discrepancies in expense order and enabling smoother data exchange with financial systems.

entries.title: Improved Tracking of User Role History
entries.description:
What’s new

  • An adjustment has been made to the user role history. The Roles tab now provides a clearer record of each role’s active periods, including start and end dates depending on the user’s status (active or inactive).

How it works

  • When a user is deactivated, the current role automatically receives an end date in the history.
  • When a user is activated, a new entry is created in the role history with the start date of the new role, without an end date.
  • If a deactivated user is later reactivated, a new entry is added to the history, indicating the new active period.
  • The start and end dates are automatically suggested by the system, but can still be manually adjusted if needed.

Benefit

  • This adjustment ensures that user role history is more complete and transparent, making it easier to track activity periods and ensuring consistent records over time.

entries.title: Resource Availability Visualization in Resource Scheduler
entries.description:
What’s new

  • Managing resource availability across teams can be challenging, especially when balancing multiple shifts and time zones. To make scheduling more intuitive and reduce the risk of overbooking, the Resource Scheduler workspace now visually represents each resource’s available capacity with a thin green bar across their timeline.

How it works

  • The green bar reflects the resource’s available hours, based on their shift timings (entry and exit) defined in their profile.
  • When a task is assigned to a resource, the green bar disappears for the occupied time slot, leaving only the unassigned (available) periods visible.
  • This visual representation updates in real-time, allowing schedulers to see available capacity at a glance and make informed allocation decisions.

Benefit

  • Schedulers gain a clear, immediate view of resource availability, helping them assign tasks efficiently, avoid conflicts, and better manage team workloads.

entries.title: Briefing Templates Now Available in Job Creation Workspace
entries.description:
What’s new

  • The use of briefing templates — already available in the standard job creation — has now been added to the new job creation workspace. These templates support the completion of briefings, ensuring that initial information is consistent and well-structured.

How it works

  • In the document description section, a combo box is available to select the desired briefing template. Once selected, the template content is automatically inserted into the job description and can be adjusted as needed.

Benefit

  • This enhancement ensures a consistent experience between standard creation and the workspace, bringing greater speed and uniformity to briefing completion.

entries.title: Tag Management Improvements
entries.description:
What’s new

  • Adjustments have been made to tags to resolve an issue where removed tags were still appearing associated with users, causing confusion. Tags now have a new property: active/inactive. Inactive tags retain old associations but cannot be linked to new documents or users.

How it works

  • Tags can only be deleted once all active associations with documents or users have been removed. If a user attempts to delete a tag that still has active associations, the system will display a clear message explaining why the deletion is not allowed.

Benefit

  • This improvement ensures accurate tag management, prevents confusion from lingering associations, and provides a transparent workflow for deleting or deactivating tags.

entries.title: Profile Photo Deletion Without UserWrite Role
entries.description:
What’s new

  • Users can now delete their own profile photo without requiring the UserWrite role.

How it works

  • The system allows a user to remove their profile photo directly. Uploading and deleting a photo now follow the same permission logic, so no additional role is needed.

Benefit

  • Simplifies profile management and provides a consistent, user-friendly experience, removing unnecessary permission barriers.

entries.title: Bulk Contract Association in Project List Workspace
entries.description:
What’s new

  • A new bulk association feature has been added to the Project workspace within a commercial client.

How it works

  • It is now possible to select multiple projects at once and associate them with a contract in bulk. This avoids the need to update each project individually.

Benefit

  • This improvement makes it easier and faster to ensure that projects are correctly linked to their corresponding contracts, reducing manual effort and potential inconsistencies.

entries.title: Automated Integration Between Purchase Orders and Project Planned Cost
entries.description:
What’s new

  • A new integration has been introduced between Purchase Orders (PO) and the Planned Costs tab in Skills. Previously, users had to manually update realized costs after finalizing a PO, which increased the risk of errors and reduced data reliability.

How it works

  • When a PO reaches the status Approved/Finalized, the system will automatically reflect the corresponding realized cost in the Planned Costs tab. The realized cost is allocated to the same period (month/year) in which the PO was finalized.
  • If no line exists for that supplier, the system will add or update it accordingly. This is powered by a new workflow action: RealPlannedCost, which updates the project’s PlannedCost.

Benefit

  • This automation ensures greater accuracy, efficiency, and reliability in managing the alignment between planned vs. realized costs, removing the need for manual updates by users.

entries.title: Bulk Role Association to Transitions
entries.description:
What’s new

  • It was identified that associating roles to transitions required a manual process, one by one, after importing transitions. This made the configuration time-consuming and inefficient.

How it works

  • A new bulk action has been added to the transitions list, allowing roles to be associated with multiple transitions simultaneously.

Benefit

  • This enhancement makes the configuration process faster, more efficient, and less error-prone, especially for clients who need to manage large sets of transitions and role associations.

entries.title: Tag Support for Query Document Type
entries.description:
What’s new

  • It is now possible to add tags to the Query document type.

How it works

  • Tags can be created and associated directly with Query documents. They can be used to organize, categorize, and quickly search for queries. Multiple tags can be applied to a single document, allowing more flexible filtering.

Benefit

  • This enhancement improves organization and discoverability of Query documents, making it easier for users to classify and retrieve information efficiently.

entries.title: Automatic Unlock for Users Logging Hours from Scheduler Workspace
entries.description:
What’s new

  • Until now, users who logged hours from the Scheduler workspace remained blocked in Skills, and the only way to unblock them was manually through the Timesheets workspace.

How it works

  • The same logic that already existed in Timesheets has been extended to the Scheduler: If a user is blocked, they will be automatically unblocked when they log their hours, whether from the Scheduler or the Timesheet.

Benefit

  • This improvement removes the need for manual intervention, ensuring a smoother and more consistent experience for users entering hours across different workspaces.

entries.title: Unit Income with Tax in Quotation Details
entries.description:
What’s new

  • A new column called “Unit Income with Tax” has been added to the quotation details.

How it works

  • Previously, only the total “Income with Tax” was available, which made it difficult to analyze items with multiple repetitions. The new column displays the final unit value (with tax) per item, calculated as:
    • Unit Income with VAT ÷ Number of Repetitions

Benefit

  • This improvement allows users to clearly see the unit selling price including tax for each item, especially in proposals that involve multiple executions/repetitions of the same service.

entries.title: Timesheet Approval Type per Client/Company
entries.description:
What's new

  • Previously, the timesheet approval type was configured in a generic way at the client level, not allowing variations per client/company. This caused inconsistencies whenever a client was serviced by more than one company, as different organizational structures often required different approval flows.

How it works now

  • The timesheet approval type is now configurable at the client/company level.

This means that each client or company can have its own customized approval model, such as:

  • Single approval
  • Double approval
  • Approval by user responsible
  • Other tailored approval flows

Benefit

  • This enhancement provides greater flexibility and accuracy in timesheet approval processes, ensuring that approval flows are aligned with each client’s or company’s organizational structure.

entries.title: Validation of Maximum Weekly Administrative Percentage
entries.description:
What's new

  • A new validation has been introduced for the “Maximum Weekly Administrative Percentage” field in the user profile.

How it works

  • Default value = 0
    • If kept at 0, the user will be able to log any amount of administrative hours without restrictions.
  • Value set > 0
    • When the user enters hours in the timesheet, the system will calculate the percentage of administrative hours for that week using the formula:

weeklyAdministrativeMinutes ÷ ( weeklyTotalMinutes + weeklyLeavesMinutes )

  • If the percentage of administrative hours exceeds the value set in the user profile, an error message will be displayed and the hours will not be added.

Benefit

  • This validation ensures greater control over the allocation of administrative hours, preventing inconsistencies in weekly timesheet reporting.

entries.title: Fix in Excel Export – Date Format in Reports
entries.description:
A bug has been fixed in the Excel export of reports, where date fields were no longer being exported with the correct format in the "Data" sheet. Previously, users had to manually adjust the column formatting in Excel to view the dates properly.

With this fix, date fields are now exported in the correct format directly from Skills, ensuring consistency and saving time during report analysis.

entries.title: New Maintenance Feature – Bulk Import Table for User–Client Associations
entries.description:
A new import table is now available to quickly assign or remove users from commercial clients using an Excel sheet.

This feature can be accessed via the advanced options in the Users workspace, and is only available to users with maintenance permissions.

It enables faster and more efficient management of user–client relationships, ideal for teams with high turnover or large account structures.

entries.title: Fix in Briefing Template Selection in the Document Creation Popup
entries.description:
A bug has been fixed in the document creation popup that prevented scrolling through the list of templates when selecting a briefing template. Previously, users were unable to scroll vertically or search for a specific template, and the only workaround was to zoom out in the browser—disrupting the user experience.

With this fix, the template list is now scrollable as expected, making the document creation process more seamless and user-friendly.

entries.title: Team Management Improvement: Inactive Users Removed from Automatic Suggestions
entries.description:
An improvement has been made to the automatic team assignment logic in activities. Previously, when adding a team to an activity, the system could automatically suggest inactive users, as long as they were plannable and met the criteria for auto-assignment — even though they wouldn't appear in name-based searches.

With this fix, inactive users are now excluded from automatic suggestions, ensuring more consistent and accurate team assignment and reducing confusion during planning.

entries.title: Fix in Comment Notification Logic
entries.description: A bug has been fixed in the notification system. Previously, when replying to a comment or adding an emoji, users were incorrectly receiving a notification about their own action. This erroneous notification has been removed to ensure users are only notified of interactions made by others.

entries.title: Improved Visibility of the "No. of Repetitions" Field in Recurring Estimates
entries.description:
In the Estimates module, whenever the "occurrence" flag is enabled, the "No. of repetitions" field is now fixed and always visible in the list of deliverables.

While this field was already mandatory, it was not always clearly displayed, which could cause confusion during data entry.

This improvement makes the process more intuitive and transparent for users.

entries.title: Fix for Navigation Between Estimates
entries.description: A bug has been fixed that caused errors when using the navigation icons to move between estimates. This issue previously prevented smooth navigation. With this fix, the navigation between estimates now works as expected.

entries.title: Estimates: New “Approved” Total in Deliverables
entries.description:
A new totalizer has been added to the Quotes section in the Estimates module.

  • It is now possible to quickly see the total value of approved deliverables within a quote.
  • This new value appears in the Deliverables section of the Quotes tab, under the label “Approved”.

This enhancement improves visibility over what has already been approved in each estimate, helping teams track progress and approval status more effectively.

entries.title: Resource Planning: Workload Retention After User Removal
entries.description:
An improvement has been made in the Resource Planning module to ensure more accurate and reliable Planned vs. Consumed workload analysis across dashboards and reports.

Previously, when a user was removed from a Job’s assignees, any associated workload was also deleted.

From this version on, the workload will no longer be removed. Instead:

  • The workload bar remains visible in the resource area, now shown with transparency.
  • The same workload can also be reviewed in the Agenda workspace.
  • A tooltip on the workload bar clearly indicates that the user is no longer part of the job’s team.

This ensures consistency in planning data and avoids the loss of historical workload information.

To remove the workload manually, users must do so directly in the Resource area by opening the edit popup for that workload and setting the value to zero. Once updated, the transparent bar will be removed from the user.

This change ensures better data continuity while still giving full control to manually clean up workloads when needed.

entries.title: Improved Image Approval and Rejection Workflow with Feed Integration
entries.description:
An update has been made to enhance the image approval and rejection process, ensuring full traceability via the document feed.

When an image is approved or rejected, a post is automatically generated in the document’s feed. If the image is rejected with comments, those comments are now also included in the feed post, providing clear context for the decision.

This update improves transparency and communication between users involved in the review process.

entries.title: Automatic Restriction on Job Creation for Blocked Projects and Clients
entries.description:
A new validation has been implemented to prevent the creation of Jobs when a Project or Client is blocked.

Previously, this validation only applied to Jobs created directly from the Project. The creation of sub-jobs or duplicated jobs could still bypass the block, unless a specific system setting was enabled.

From now on, whenever a Project or Client is blocked, the system will automatically prevent job creation at all levels, including:

  • Creating new jobs manually
  • Duplicating existing jobs
  • Creating sub-jobs

If attempted, the user will receive an appropriate error message, ensuring consistency and preventing unintended activity creation under restricted entities.

entries.title: Automatic Refresh After Changes in Preview Mode
entries.description:
We’ve improved the experience when editing documents via the preview popup.

Previously, changes (such as status updates) were not immediately reflected in the main list — requiring users to refresh the page manually. With this new improvement, the list now updates automatically after actions taken in the preview popup, such as job stage changes.

This behavior has been implemented in key views like Jobs, and the solution is now ready to be extended quickly to other areas upon request.

entries.title: Briefing Templates by Project Type
entries.description:
To help standardize project creation and ensure the right information is collected from the beginning, we’ve expanded the briefing template functionality.

It is now possible to associate briefing templates with project types — not just with jobs. This allows different templates to be automatically applied based on the project type, streamlining the briefing process and improving consistency across teams.

entries.title: New Image Approval Workflow
entries.description:
A new image approval feature has been introduced to bring structure and traceability to creative validation processes.

With this new functionality, teams can now:

  • Upload images directly in the feed
  • View images in a gallery or fullscreen modal
  • Approve or Reject images, optionally adding comments
  • Access a full approval history, including who approved/rejected and when
  • Automatically register all actions in the document feed, ensuring transparency

This new flow improves collaboration, accountability, and clarity in the creative approval process.

entries.title: Improved Rate Card Configuration with Company, Division, and Department Scope
entries.description:
The Rate Card table has been enhanced to support more accurate and flexible configurations in environments where Typology Groups are shared across multiple companies.

Previously, Typology Groups were associated using a simple list, without the ability to distinguish between different companies, divisions, or departments. This created ambiguity and potential errors when applying rates in more complex organizational structures.

To resolve this, the simple list has been replaced with an association table that includes the following fields:

  • Company
  • Division
  • Department
  • Typology Group

How it works:

  • If Company, Division, and Department fields are left empty, the rate applies globally to all.
  • If values are defined, the system applies the rate specifically based on the selected scope.

This update ensures better control over rate application while maintaining compatibility with shared typology group setups.

entries.title: Enhanced Typology Group Selection and Rate Matching per Company in Estimates
entries.description:
A new feature has been introduced to improve how Typology Groups and rates are applied across shared company structures in Estimates and Rate Cards.

Typology Group Selection in Estimates

  • When creating or editing an Estimate where the Estimate Company (e.g., Agency 1) is not the main company of a Typology Group but is listed under its Companies tab, the group is now correctly shown in the selection grid.
  • The select box displays all valid combinations, including departments from Agency 1, 2, and 3, if they are associated with the group.

Rate Matching Logic in Estimates

  • If the Rate Card table contains only one entry for a Typology Group with empty Company, Division, and Department fields, the rate is considered global and applied to all companies.
  • If the Rate Card table includes specific combinations per company/division/department, the estimate will use the matching rate based on the Estimate’s configuration.

This update ensures more accurate and flexible application of rates in multi-company environments while maintaining backward compatibility for simpler setups.

entries.title: Improved Annotation Editing Experience in Video Viewer
entries.description:
A usability issue has been addressed in the video annotation feature, where users perceived that only the last annotation was saved, leading to confusion and frustration.

This happened because clicking on an annotation automatically entered edit mode, and switching to another annotation without explicitly closing or saving the current one caused the interface to remain locked in the previous edit. Although all annotations were correctly stored, they were not immediately visible or accessible.

To improve the user experience, the system now shows a warning when the user tries to leave an annotation in edit mode without saving or closing it.

This ensures that no changes are unintentionally lost and provides a clearer, more reliable editing experience.

entries.title: Feed Locking on Blocked Documents
entries.description:
A new configuration option has been added to the Blocked action in workflow transitions: the "comment" parameter. When this parameter is enabled, the feed section of the document is locked once the transition is executed.

From that moment on, users can no longer add comments, replies, or edit existing messages. The system will display an alert indicating that the document is blocked.

This functionality can be applied to any type of document, ensuring no further communication occurs after the item is finalized or intentionally closed.

To unlock the feed, the same logic applies: simply add the "comment" parameter to the Unblock action in the transition. This will restore the ability to interact with the feed.

entries.title: New Access Control Roles for Margin Fields in Estimate Details
entries.description:
New access roles have been created to manage visibility of margin fields within the estimate detail section of proposals. Previously, margin visibility profiles only applied to the INFO section of Estimates, not to individual deliverable details.

The following roles have been introduced to provide more granular control:

  • DeliverableFinalMarginRead – Final Margin, Final Margin %
  • DeliverableGrossMarginRead – Gross Margin, Gross Margin %
  • DeliverableMarginRead – Margin, Final Margin including taxes

Note: These new roles have been added by default to the EstimateRead role to maintain compatibility across environments. To fully use this feature, you must remove these roles from EstimateRead and assign them explicitly to the appropriate user profiles.

entries.title: Improved Visibility Rules for HR-Only Leave Approvals
entries.description:
An adjustment has been made to the leave approval process: HRApprovalOnly leaves are now hidden from the User Responsible until they are approved by HR. These requests will only be visible to the designated HR Approver during the initial review phase.
This prevents direct managers from approving leave requests that were intended exclusively for HR review, ensuring the correct approval flow is respected.

entries.title: Enhanced Timesheet Import with Visual Feedback
entries.description:
The timesheet import grid has been improved to provide clear visual feedback on the import status. Rows that are successfully imported now appear in green, while chunks of rows that encounter API errors are highlighted in red.
This enhancement makes it easier to identify and troubleshoot issues during import. For now, this update applies only to Timesheets — other object types will be updated progressively.

entries.title: Improved Alignment for Number Fields
entries.description:
Number fields across the platform are now right-aligned, following standard usability conventions for numerical data. Previously, numbers were aligned to the left, which could make them harder to read and compare.
This adjustment improves readability, especially in financial and data entry contexts, making the interface more intuitive for users handling numeric values.

entries.title: Consistent Honorary Percentage Display when Adding/Editing Budget Lines
entries.description:
An inconsistency was fixed in the process of adding or editing new lines in the budget, where the honorary percentage (% Honoraries) displayed during the process did not match the value shown after saving. This could cause confusion when reviewing service lines that included pre-configured honoraries.

With this update, the honorary percentage shown during the addition or editing of budget lines now remains consistent after saving, reflecting the correct stored value from the system.

entries.title: Margin Totals added to Deliverables section in Estimates
entries.description:
It is now possible to view the total values for Margins (both absolute and percentage) in the Deliverables section of Estimates. Previously, this information was not summarized, making it harder to quickly understand overall profitability.

With this update, margin totals are clearly displayed, improving visibility and supporting faster decision-making during the budgeting process.

entries.title: Improvement in Planned Hours generation from multiple estimates
entries.description:
Improvements have been made to the logic for generating Planned Hours when multiple estimates are associated with the same project. Previously, if the estimates included the same job role groups, the contracted hours were not being summed correctly.

Additionally, when one of the estimates was rejected, all hours — including those from estimates that were not rejected — were incorrectly removed. With this update, the system now correctly takes existing hours into account when generating new Planned Hours, ensuring that contracted values reflect the actual sum of all approved estimates.

entries.title: Notifications when mentioning users in the Client feed
entries.description:
It is now possible to mention users in a Client’s feed and ensure they receive both a notification and an automatic email. This feature, already available in Projects and Jobs, has been extended to the Client area, improving team communication from the moment a commercial client is created.

Note: To be mentioned and notified, the user must be active and plannable in their user profile.

entries.title: Billing Percentage Suggestion for Clients
entries.description:
To streamline the billing process in the estimate workflow, a new feature has been introduced that automatically suggests the billing percentage for clients. Previously, users had to manually select the billing conditions each time they processed a budget, which added unnecessary time to the workflow.

Now, the billing percentage is defined directly in the Billing Clients settings, ensuring that this crucial information is available when creating budgets. This automatic suggestion is designed to save time and reduce errors in the billing process, as the system will pre-fill the billing percentage based on the default data for each client.

This feature ensures that the billing percentage is correctly applied to the budget, directly contributing to more efficient and accurate invoicing. By reducing manual input, users can focus more on other aspects of the budget, speeding up the overall budgeting and invoicing process.

entries.title: Document Feed Filters
entries.description:
A new feature has been introduced to allow filtering in the document feed, providing a faster way to access information, especially in documents with high activity. This makes it easier for users to find specific posts and actions within the feed.

Activation: To enable this feature, go to the Feed panel settings and turn on the feature under 'Toolbar' > 'Visible'.

Filter Options: Once activated, users can filter posts based on a variety of actions, including:

  • Post with Transitions
  • Post with Files
  • Post with Assignments
  • Post with Motives
  • Post with Changed End Dates
  • Post with Additional Informations
  • Post with Timesheets
  • Post with Notifications
  • Post with Items
  • Posts Created by Me
  • Post with Comments
  • Post with Replies
  • Post with Visible to Client
  • Post with Reactions
  • Post Edited

This feature provides users with a faster and more efficient way to navigate and manage documents with extensive activity.

entries.title: Bug Fix in Resource View
entries.description:
A correction has been made in the Resource Planning View, specifically addressing an issue that arose when moving tasks between users. Previously, when dragging tasks to a new user, a bug caused the old executor to remain assigned to the task, even though the new user was added.

This issue has now been resolved, ensuring that when tasks are moved between users, the old executor is properly removed, and only the newly assigned user remains as the task executor. This fix improves the accuracy of task assignments and enhances the overall task management process.

entries.title: Enhancements to the Job List in Workspaces
entries.description:
The Job List in workspaces has been improved, offering several advantages over the system’s default lists. In addition to supporting custom views and displaying additional fields, inline editing is now available, providing greater flexibility and efficiency for users.

With this release, the Priority field, which was previously not editable inline, has been added to the inline editing options, further enhancing the user experience and facilitating quicker updates directly from the list view.

Additionally, a problem related to Excel exports has been addressed. Now, when exporting the Job List to Excel, the Link column correctly includes a clickable hyperlink, allowing users to navigate directly to the corresponding records.

entries.title: Proofing for File Approvals
entries.description:
A new Proofing feature has been introduced, allowing files to have a workflow for approvals. This functionality provides greater control over file validation processes and is available exclusively within the workspace context.

Activation: To enable this feature, activate the "Enable file approval" setting. Additionally, it is required to replace the document feed and the files tab with their corresponding workspace versions, both available in the marketplace.

Approval/Reject Options: Users can approve or reject files through the following methods:

  • In the image preview
  • Directly from the files tab

When an image is rejected, providing a reason is mandatory. This rejection reason will be visible:

  • In the file details (preview mode)
  • In the tooltip when hovering over the file name

This is an initial implementation of the Proofing feature, and it will be further enhanced in future releases based on user feedback and requirements.

entries.title: Fix for Timesheet Cost Synchronization
entries.description: The Sync Timesheet Cost option, available in the Monthly Costs workspace within the user profile, allows updating previously registered timesheets with new hourly rates when user costs change over time. This option was returning an error, which has now been fixed, ensuring that timesheet costs are synchronized correctly.

entries.title: Fix for Copying Estimate Lines and Details
entries.description:
A problem in the budget line copying functionality has been fixed. Previously, when copying lines from an older budget version to a newer one, the system allowed the inclusion of Services, Expenses, and Resources. However, the deliverable details were not copied, resulting in zero values.

With this fix, when copying lines from a previous budget version, all associated details, including deliverables, are now correctly replicated, ensuring data consistency across budget versions.

entries.title: UX Improvements in Warning Display
entries.description:
To enhance the user experience (UX) and improve message clarity, warnings are now displayed in orange toasts instead of red. This change helps users distinguish between warnings and critical errors, reducing misunderstandings about system failures.

Additionally, the API has been updated to ensure it correctly returns a warning status instead of an error status when applicable, providing more accurate feedback and improving system reliability.

entries.title: Enhancement in Job Type Duration
entries.description: The job type duration functionality has been improved. When creating jobs, it is now possible to set a predefined duration based on the job type configuration. Previously, the duration field—represented in hours—was limited to a maximum of 999:00 hours. With this enhancement, the editor has been updated to allow the creation of jobs with a longer duration, providing greater flexibility in time management.

entries.title: Improved Resource Scheduler Workspace
entries.description:
We've made several enhancements to the Resource Scheduler workspace to improve visibility and efficiency when managing resources.

  • Client Filter: When filtering by client, you will now see only the users working on that specific client.
  • Project Filter: When filtering by project, only the users assigned to that project will be displayed.
  • User Role Display: The user's role is now shown next to their name in the Resources section, providing better context when assigning and managing tasks.

These improvements allow for more precise and relevant resource filtering, improving clarity in team allocations and enhancing visibility of user roles for better decision-making.

entries.title: Improved Workload Allocation for Absence Days
entries.description:
An improvement has been made to the workload allocation process, allowing users to add tasks on days when they have recorded an absence, such as vacation days.

This enhancement provides greater flexibility in scheduling workloads, ensuring more efficient resource planning even during absence periods.

entries.title: Improved Document Lists and Custom Views in Workspace
entries.description:
The new document lists in Workspace represent a significant improvement in how documents are viewed and managed. Users can now create custom views with personalized fields and filters for each area, offering greater flexibility and organization. Additionally, common users can create their own custom views and organizations to better manage their workflows.

To improve the experience further, access controls for editing custom views have been enhanced. Users with the CustomViewSave role can now create private views, while users with the PublicViewSave role can create public views and share them with specific teams. Users with the WorkspaceViewWrite role now have the ability to deactivate standard views, which are the default views provided with the workspace installation. This ensures that, in certain contexts, only the most relevant views are available to users.

entries.title: Improved Text Editing Toolbar in Feed Comments
entries.description:
We've enhanced the text editing experience in feed comments by introducing a fixed toolbar for formatting options. This improvement ensures a smoother and more intuitive editing process, making it easier to format text at any position within the comment.

With this update, users can now access all formatting tools effortlessly, ensuring a more seamless and consistent writing experience.

entries.title: Increment Parent Estimate Version in Workflow
entries.description:
The CreateVersion action used in estimates has been improved to allow automatic incrementing of the parent estimate version when a new child version is created. Previously, this action only affected the current document, and it was not possible to update the parent estimate version directly from the child. This limitation required users to manually adjust the parent version, increasing the risk of inconsistencies.

With this enhancement, users can now configure the action to increment the parent estimate version seamlessly. To enable this functionality, simply add the "IncrementParent" option in the action settings within the transition configuration. This improvement simplifies version management and ensures better traceability of estimate changes.

entries.title: Enhanced Estimate Copy Process
entries.description:
An improvement has been made to the estimate copy process. Previously, all fields were copied to the new estimate, regardless of whether they were active or discontinued, such as ratecard tables and columns.

Now, the copy process takes the status of the fields into account, ensuring that only fields that are still active are copied to the new estimate, preventing discontinued or inactive values from being transferred.

entries.title: Fix for PDF Export Issue
entries.description:
A bug has been fixed in the PDF export process. When the document title contained special characters, such as periods, the file was exported in the wrong format.

With this fix, documents are now correctly exported to the PDF format, regardless of characters in the title.

entries.title: Fix for Incorrect Team Recalculation in Jobs
entries.description:
We identified an issue where changing the Project Type caused the teams in Jobs to be recalculated to their initial settings, even when they had been manually modified.

With this fix, the system now retains the previously adjusted teams in the documents, ensuring that changes to the Project Type do not unintentionally affect team allocations.

entries.title: Fix for Incorrect Holiday Date Display in Timesheet
entries.description:
An issue was identified when creating or editing a Holiday, where the date displayed in the Timesheet grid was incorrect due to a timezone-related error. To ensure the correct date appeared, users had to manually set the date to D+1, as saving the record caused the system to register it as D-1 (as shown in the attached video).

This issue has now been fixed, ensuring that holidays are saved and displayed correctly in the Timesheet grid, regardless of the timezone.

entries.title: Improved Inflation Rate Application in Estimates
entries.description:
A new enhancement has been implemented in the Estimates module to ensure a more accurate cost calculation. The Inflation Rate stored in the Estimate Info was previously applied only to Resource Lines, leaving Service Lines unaffected.

With this improvement, the Inflation Rate is now consistently applied to both Resource Lines and Service Lines, providing a more precise and reliable budget estimation process. Additionally, users who wish to copy existing estimates and apply an inflation rate can now do so easily by simply filling in the Inflation Rate field in the Estimate Info, streamlining the adjustment process.

entries.title: State Modification for Documents with Integration Errors
entries.description:
An improvement has been made to allow the modification of the status of documents, even when there are errors during the integration process with SAGE. This enhancement ensures smoother management of documents, enabling users to update the status despite integration issues.

Documents affected:

  • Invoice Authorization
  • Credit Note
  • Purchase Order

By enabling status modification even in the presence of errors, users can take immediate action and maintain control over the process.

entries.title: Planned Time Adjustment - Workspace Resources Days Update
entries.description:
An adjustment has been made in the Planned Time area within the Workspace Resources Days.

In the previous setup, when requesting an adjustment, all planned hours from the different sub-estimates were deleted from the project planning through the action DeletePlannedHoursDeliverableFromEstimateItemDetails.

Now, it is possible to delete only the lines related to the specific estimate that needs editing, preserving the planned hours for other sub-estimates.

This adjustment provides the benefit of greater accuracy and control in project planning, allowing only the planned hours for the specific estimate to be modified without affecting other sub-estimates. This reduces the risk of errors and rework, while offering a more efficient and flexible management of contracted hours, improving organization within the Workspace Resources Days.

entries.title: Kanban Improvements and Drag & Drop Enhancements
entries.description:
A refactoring of the kanbans was carried out to improve code structure and organization.

The Drag and Drop functionality was fixed to ensure that unsupported stages and transitions are not hidden. Now, when moving cards, invalid states appear in red, allowing users to identify that the transition is not allowed.

The layout has been updated with visual and informational improvements. For example, the parent document information was added to the card, and colors were adjusted for a better user experience.

entries.title: Mass Expense Import Feature
entries.description:
To streamline the expense entry process and facilitate registration across different platforms, the option for mass import has been made available.

Within the respective expense sheet, users can import data using a standardized template, ensuring convenience and consistency in data entry.

A standard importer has been created with the following basic fields:

  • Name
  • Start Date
  • End Date
  • Division
  • Department
  • Type
  • Expense Type
  • Supplier
  • Client
  • Project
  • Value with Tax

This importer is available in the expense list within the workspace.

entries.title: Typology Document Update: User Fields Addition
entries.description: The Typology document has been updated to include the possibility of creating associated user fields. These fields allow for the addition of specific details, similar to what is available in jobs, projects, clients, and other documents.

entries.title: Unable to Add Annotations to Videos
entries.description: A fix has been implemented to restore the ability to add annotations to videos, ensuring proper functionality.

entries.title: Enhanced User Creation and Cost Duplication Control
entries.description: A new improvement has been added to the user creation process. When duplicating a user, the monthly cost was previously copied by default, which may not always be desired. Now, a new parameter has been added to the workspace, allowing agencies to individually configure whether or not the monthly cost should be copied when duplicating a user. This customization ensures more flexibility in managing user creation and cost duplication according to agency preferences.

entries.title: Improved Leave Management and Validation
entries.description:
A new enhancement has been added to the leave management system. Previously, users with locked timesheets could modify their past absences, which could lead to issues if the company had a defined filling tolerance. If a user changed an absence for a past date within a locked period, they could become locked out of the system, unable to fill timesheets and continue working.

Now, deleting or modifying past leaves is validated by the CloseVacationsPeriod setting in the company configuration. Users are no longer able to delete leaves that fall before this date, ensuring better control and preventing issues with timesheet filling and system access.

entries.title: New Sorting Feature for Document List Views
entries.description:
A new sorting feature has been added to the existing document list views, both public and private. With the introduction of the order property, users can now arrange their views in a logical sequence. This enhancement provides greater flexibility and organization when managing document views.

If the new lists have not yet been implemented in your environment, you can request the update for them.

entries.title: Improved Workload Planning in Resource Management
entries.description: A new improvement has been implemented in the resource management area to enhance workload planning. Now, when assigning workloads to a user, the system ensures that no more than 24 hours can be scheduled per day. An alert is displayed if this limit is exceeded, promoting clearer and more accurate planning.

entries.title: Improved Annotation Feature
entries.description: The annotation feature has been enhanced to address a specific issue with vertical layout images. Previously, the screen would become misaligned, and the "Save Comment" option would not appear when adding comments. This problem has been fixed, ensuring a seamless and functional annotation experience across all layout formats.

entries.title: Fix for Tax Adjustment Errors in Estimate Deliverables
entries.description: A bug in the budget area has been resolved. Previously, when a deliverable inherited a default tax value, changing this value during creation would cause an error in the discount cells. This issue has been corrected, ensuring accurate display and functionality when modifying tax values.

entries.title: Enhanced Workspace Access Control
entries.description:
Workspace access management has been enhanced with a more flexible permission structure. Previously, any changes to roles, translations, or parameters required full access through the "DashboardWrite" role. With this update, specific permissions can now be assigned, such as "WorkspaceRolesWrite," which allows users to manage workspace roles exclusively.

Additionally, new controls are under development, including "WorkspaceParametersWrite" for editing parameters, "WorkspaceTranslationsWrite" for managing translations, and "WorkspaceImport" for access to features like Import and Export. These improvements provide greater security and granular control over workspace configurations.

entries.title: Rate Card Duplication Behavior Adjustment
entries.description: An adjustment has been made to the behavior when duplicating a budget with an inactive Rate Card. Now, when the Rate Card is inactive and the budget is duplicated, the Rate Card field and associated column will be cleared, allowing the user to select the correct Rate Card for the new budget. This ensures that the proper Rate Card is chosen, avoiding the use of outdated data.

entries.title: Bug Fix in Budget Service Section
entries.description: A bug has been fixed in the service section of budgets, where, after adding a service line with a defined fee margin and then changing the supplier or condition (modifying the line), the suggested percentage for the fee margin was cleared before entering the values. Now, the suggested percentage will remain intact even after changing the supplier or condition, ensuring greater consistency in the data.

entries.title: Adjustment in Job Type Association for Shared Clients
entries.description:
An adjustment has been made to the feature that allows the association of job types by client. Previously, for shared commercial clients across multiple companies, document creation was limited to the job types associated, regardless of the company, causing unwanted restrictions across different companies.

Now, the system considers the company of the departments and the associated job types. With this change, if only company 1's job types are associated, the restriction on job creation will apply only to that company. Company 2 will follow the normal flow, allowing job creation for the active and plannable departments defined for that company.

entries.title: Adjustment in Estimate Calculations
entries.description:
A new Service Calculus Type field has been added to Payment Conditions, similar to the existing functionality at the Company level.

  • If this field is left empty, service calculations will follow the settings defined at the Company level (existing behavior).
  • If a Payment Condition with a defined Service Calculus Type is selected, the Estimate Detail will use it for calculations, overriding the Company settings.

This adjustment provides greater flexibility and precision in budget calculations.

entries.title: Bug Fix in Document Feed Comment Editing
entries.description: A bug has been fixed in the document feed comment editing feature, where the original formatting, particularly spaces, was lost upon editing. Now, when editing a comment in the document feed, the formatting is preserved, ensuring that spaces and other formatting elements remain intact.

entries.title: Adjustment in Timesheet Approval Process
entries.description:
An issue in the Timesheet Approval process has been resolved, affecting scenarios with multiple approval levels. Previously, even if the first application completed its approval, both the timesheet and the second application would remain locked if the second application had not yet been approved.

With multiple approval levels enabled and approver blocking activated, the system now distinguishes each approver's level and role. This ensures that approvers are not blocked because the next level in the chain has not yet completed their approval, allowing the process to continue smoothly.

entries.title: New Timesheet Approval Method
entries.description:
A new method for marking and approving timesheets has been introduced. In addition to the existing methods (user responsible, project owner, client manager, and their hierarchical variants), it is now possible to define custom approval rules through a query.

This method requires additional configuration, including the setup of a user field, and should be implemented with the support of the consulting team. The query has access to the parameters TimesheetIds or Ids and must return a list containing TimesheetId, ApproverId, and Order. When a timesheet is sent for approval—either automatically upon creation or by clicking the request approval button—the query will execute, dynamically assigning the approvers based on the defined logic.

entries.title: Bug Fix in User Profile Editing
entries.description: A bug affecting the editing of the user profile has been resolved. Previously, when a user was moved to a new company, the Employee module required duplicating the full name to link it to the new company. Attempting to update the company directly would result in an error. This issue has been fixed, allowing seamless updates to the company without requiring duplication of the user’s name.

entries.title: Bug Fix in Purchase Order Creation
entries.description: Previously, the Delivery Date field defaulted to January 1, 0001 when creating a Purchase Order, even if left unfilled. This has been corrected, and the field now remains empty by default, as intended, providing greater flexibility during the creation process.

entries.title: Adjustment to Timesheets
entries.description: Previously, invalid timesheets were considered as pending for the user. A change has been made so that timesheets with errors are now displayed as hours missing when they have not yet been approved. Once approved, these timesheets will appear on the calendar as closed days, indicating that they have been validated by the approver.

entries.title: Improvements have been made to the financial module.
entries.description:
Estimates can now be created using automatically generated service templates, configured in the Workloads section at the service level. This feature streamlines the estimation of multiple services under a single estimate, improving efficiency.

Key adjustments have also been implemented: estimate lines now correctly inherit rates from the ratecard, and a new "Default Rate" column has been added, allowing costs to automatically follow the values defined in the service table, when applicable. These updates enhance accuracy and reduce manual effort in estimate creation.

entries.title: Enhanced Automatic Estimate Recalculation Feature
entries.description: Improvements have been made to the financial module. The budget values will now be automatically recalculated based on the fields defined in the document information. If, after creating the budget, the user decides to adjust fields such as "Resource Margin," "Supplier Margin," "Overhead," or "Rate and Price Table," a confirmation message will be displayed. Upon confirmation, the system will recalculate the budget values according to the new settings.

entries.title: Enhanced User Audit with Month and Year Filter
entries.description:
A month and year filter has been added to the User Audit section. Now, users can more efficiently review the audit history by selecting specific periods for analysis. This feature allows quick navigation between different months and years, making it easier to consult past events in the system.

Benefits:

  • Improves efficiency when searching for audit information.
  • Quick access to data from previous months and years.
  • Facilitates detailed analysis of past periods.

entries.title: Enhanced Monthly Cost Synchronization Feature for Timesheets
entries.description:
A new option has been created to facilitate the bulk synchronization of monthly costs for users. Previously, updating the costs of registered timesheets required individual synchronization for each user, making it impractical, especially when multiple user costs are updated simultaneously through a spreadsheet. Now, this bulk synchronization feature is available in two places:

  1. During the bulk import process (Advanced), users can now choose whether to affect already registered timesheets when importing costs.
  2. In the Users workspace, users can take bulk actions by selecting the users to be synchronized, considering all loaded months.

This enhancement streamlines the process, saving time and effort in managing timesheet costs.

entries.title: Service Commission Configuration by Client in Estimate Module
entries.description:
A new configuration for service commission percentages by client has been introduced in the budget module. Users can now access the commercial client profile to set up the services and the corresponding commission percentages they wish to consider for calculating the sale price of the service.

Additionally, when creating a budget, the system will automatically suggest the defined percentage for the selected client and service in the services section. This enhancement simplifies the budgeting process, ensuring that commission rates are consistently applied based on client specifications.

entries.title: Enhanced Service Workload Configuration in Estimate Module
entries.description: A new configuration has been added to the job type within the estimate module, allowing clients to set up the workload for specific services and estimate multiple services under the same estimate. Additionally, the workload option is now linked to each service, providing a template of the required resources. The rate card column is also pre-filled with the values defined in the Rate Card table associated with the estimate. Furthermore, the system now supports decimal hour input, allowing users to enter values like 2 hours and 15 minutes as 2.15 hours.

entries.title: Purchase Order Process Enhancement in Esitmate Module
entries.description:
Our system is versatile and allows the creation of internal budgets where the budget provider is another registered company in the system. However, when a budget is approved and purchase orders (POs) are generated, POs are created for all suppliers, including those from the other company, which often doesn't make sense in these cases. Accounts teams frequently overlooked the need to remove approval for the budget line in such situations.

To streamline this process, a new setting has been added for suppliers, allowing the finance or maintenance team to indicate whether a purchase order should be generated for that supplier even if the budget line is approved. This enhancement simplifies management and reduces the risk of oversight in the purchase order generation process.

entries.title: Fixed Copy and Paste Issue for Document Links
entries.description: The copy and paste feature for document numbers was not working properly. Depending on where the document link was pasted, it would appear as plain text without a hyperlink. This issue has been resolved, ensuring that the document link is always pasted with the correct hyperlink formatting.

entries.title: Fixed Unable to Mention People in Document Feed When Searching by "user.name"
entries.description: A bug has been fixed that prevented users from mentioning people in the document feed when searching using the "user.name" format. The system did not correctly recognize the dot in the name, which caused the mention feature to fail. With this update, support for dots in usernames has been added, ensuring that mentions now work properly in the document feed, even when the names include this character.

entries.title: Fix for Incorrect Value-Based Invoicing
entries.description: A correction has been made in value-based invoicing as defined in the general invoicing conditions. Previously, the system was generating invoices without accounting for previously invoiced amounts, leading to incorrect values in subsequent invoices. This issue has been fixed, ensuring that value-based invoicing is now correctly calculated, taking into account amounts already invoiced.

entries.title: Enhancements to Estimate Deliverables
entries.description:
Recent updates to the estimate feature include new columns in the "Deliverables" section to enhance financial reporting.

New Columns Added:

  • Gross Margin: A new column named "Gross Margin" has been introduced. This column displays the Gross Margin, calculated as the difference between Total Sales and Total Purchase Cost of Services.
  • Value and Percentage: The Gross Margin is now available in both value and percentage formats, providing a clear view of both the absolute margin and its proportion relative to total sales.

entries.title: Leave Management in Resource Schedule
entries.description: When a leave is allocated but not sent for approval (draft status), it will no longer be displayed in the resource schedule, ensuring that only leaves sent for approval or already approved affect resource availability. This prevents incorrect interpretations of user availability. Additionally, a filter button has been added that allows only approved or HR-approved leaves to be displayed. The state of this button will be saved locally, so the user's preference is maintained in future views.

entries.title: Enhanced Job List Features in Workspace
entries.description:
New feature have been added to the job list workspace to improve navigation and document management. These enhancements offer greater flexibility and ease of use.

Right-click Options: Users can now:

  • Copy Number and Name: Quickly copy the document number and name for use elsewhere.
  • Copy Link: Copy the direct link to the document for easy sharing or reference.
  • Open in New Tab: Open the document in a new browser tab for better multitasking.
  • Send via Email: Send the document directly via email from the right-click menu.

These feature streamline interactions with documents, enhancing productivity and user experience.

entries.title: Update to User Mentions in Document Feed
entries.description: In the document feed feature, which allows users to mention other users, the system previously displayed the name defined in the "name" field instead of the user name.
