To ensure consistency with assignments, mentions in the feed now correctly display the user name. This update aligns the display of user information across the platform.

entries.title: Added Ordering for Project Type Tasks
entries.description: A new feature has been introduced to enhance task organization when creating projects. This feature adds an order field to the Project Type configuration, which determines the sequence of tasks created automatically. The specified order will now be used as a reference during project setup, ensuring tasks are arranged according to the stages defined by the agency. This ordering will be visible in the Gantt chart under the Order column and in the job list for the project, providing a more structured and intuitive project management experience.

entries.title: Enhanced Gantt Workspace - Copy and Paste Jobs
entries.description: The new Gantt version in workspace format now includes the ability to copy and paste jobs between projects. Users can select the rows they want to copy, right-click to copy them, and then navigate to the new project within the same browser. Jobs can be pasted directly into the Gantt chart of the new project, facilitating easier project management and data transfer.

entries.title: Kanban Filter Preservation Fix
entries.description: A fix has been implemented to ensure that the filter in Kanban is preserved when adjusting the date range or other settings in the Kanban toolbar. Previously, changing the date range would cause the system to lose the initial Project filter, but now all active filters will remain intact during such adjustments, enhancing the filtering experience and improving usability.

entries.title: Excel Export for Pivot Grid
entries.description: The issue where the Excel export button for Pivot Grid stopped functioning has been resolved. Previously, it was not possible to export workspaces with grids to Excel. This bug has been fixed, restoring the ability to export data as needed.

entries.title: User Working Hours Configuration
entries.description:
Agencies can now set specific working hours for each user on a daily basis. This feature allows for customization of working hours according to the needs of different users.

  • A new "Working Hours" tab has been added to the user maintenance profile, providing an interface to define working hours per day for each user.
  • For User Companies with Attendance enabled, a new day total will appear, reflecting the defined working hours.

This feature is purely informational and does not influence timesheet locking.

entries.title: Annotation Error on Files Uploaded by Other Users
entries.description: Fixed a bug where users encountered an error message when attempting to add annotations or comments to files uploaded by other users. This issue has now been resolved, allowing seamless collaboration by ensuring that all users can annotate any file, regardless of the uploader. This fix improves the overall user experience and enhances the platform's collaborative capabilities.

entries.title: Rate Card Filter Enhancement: Filter by Project Company
entries.description:
In the Project Info section, the rate card field was previously filtered by the user's company. With this new feature, the rate card is now filtered based on the project company, ensuring that the correct rates are displayed.

This change aligns the rate card filtering mechanism with that used in the Estimate section, improving consistency across the platform and reducing the chance of errors related to incorrect rate selection.

entries.title: Gantt Workspace Version
entries.description:
A new Gantt version has been created in a workspace format. This version allows for greater customization and faster development due to its flexible structure.

  • Added duration label to column data, allowing 3 decimal places.
  • Enabled a drag-to-copy feature, allowing users to drag cells and copy/paste values between rows.
  • Added color to cells in the status column for better visual distinction.

entries.title: Update to Timesheet Responsible Changes
entries.description:
Previously, when the responsible person for a user changed, the system would automatically update the approver for all timesheets, including those that were already approved.

With the new process, only timesheets that are still pending approval will be updated with the new responsible person. This ensures that you can still track who approved past timesheets even if the responsible person changes.

If you need to update the approver for past timesheets, you can do so by using the "Sync Timesheet Approvals" button in the user responsible workspace settings. This will perform a complete update for all timesheets.

entries.title: Job Creation Issue
entries.description: The bug preventing job creation when job types with the flag "Accessible to all departments" were set has been resolved. Users can now create jobs as expected, regardless of this flag's settings.

entries.title: Enhanced Decimal Precision in Estimate Info and Services Grid
entries.description: The Resource Margin, Supplier Margin, Overheads, and Inflation fields in the Estimate Info section have been updated to support more decimal places. Additionally, the Margin % field in the Services grid now allows for greater decimal precision, enabling more accurate calculations and estimates.

entries.title: Improved Rate Card Import Process
entries.description:
Improvements have been made to the rate card import process to enhance efficiency. The requirement for non-mandatory fields, such as User and Market, has been removed. Users can now import rate tables via Excel, reducing manual work.

This functionality is available in the Rate Cards document under the Quotes tab and can be accessed using an Excel spreadsheet provided in that section.

entries.title: Date Field in Annotations
entries.description: The annotation tool now includes a date field. Users can see not only who made the annotations and at what time, but also the exact day when the annotations were added to the images.

entries.title: Mark Documents as Read or Unread
entries.description: The ability to mark documents as "Read" or "Unread" has been added. This feature is available in the new document lists in Workspace. To take advantage of this feature, users should request the replacement of the default lists with the Workspace lists.

entries.title: Restricted Editing for Rate Card/Price Table Fields
entries.description: Added the ability to restrict editing of the rate card/price table and rate card/price table column fields in Estimate Info to specific users. Previously, these fields were editable by anyone with permission to edit the estimate. Now, the ability to limit editing of these specific fields has been implemented. Configuration can be done in maintenance, within the workspace of document members, where profiles authorized to edit these fields can be defined.

entries.title: User Role Audit Events
entries.description: We have added the ability to log events related to the addition and removal of roles in the user audit system. Now, whenever a role is added to or removed from a user, the event will be recorded in the audit logs, providing more detailed and precise monitoring of permission changes within the system.

entries.title: Estimate Service Section Enhancement
entries.description: A new column, called "Service Total Cost," has been added to the services section in estimates. Users can manually add this column using the column chooser, enabling them to differentiate the total purchase amount in the budget with and without resources. This enhancement allows for quick identification of external costs versus the total, providing clearer financial insights.

entries.title: Enhanced Kanban Functionality: Inline Card Editing for Assignees
entries.description: We have significantly enhanced the kanban functionality. Users can now edit cards inline, specifically the assignee field, allowing for quick and efficient adjustments directly on the kanban board. This improvement makes task management more agile and intuitive, eliminating the need for multiple clicks and navigation between different screens. With this update, we ensure a smoother user experience and increased team productivity.

entries.title: Automatic Redirect to Login on Session Timeout
entries.description: Implemented a feature to detect when the session is lost and automatically redirect the user to the login page instead of displaying a message that live updates are not available. If multiple tabs are open, re-login is only required in one tab.

entries.title: Error Occurs When Posting to User's Feed
entries.description: Resolved an issue where the system would generate an error when posting to the user's feed.

entries.title: Resource Scheduler Enhancement: Automatic Refresh for Task Executors
entries.description: Adjustments have been made to the Resource Scheduler (Default). Previously, when multiple executors were assigned to a task via the popup, the scheduler did not refresh automatically. If the task was then moved to change its start or end date, the scheduler would revalidate the executors and remove those added through the popup, causing users to lose control of their assigned tasks. Now, the scheduler refreshes automatically, ensuring that executors added via the popup are not incorrectly excluded. This improvement ensures better task management and maintains the integrity of user assignments.

entries.title: Significant Performance Improvements in Scheduler
entries.description: The latest release includes significant performance enhancements to the Resource Scheduler. These improvements ensure faster loading times, more efficient task management, and a smoother user experience. The scheduler now handles large volumes of tasks and executors more effectively. Users will notice quicker updates and reduced lag, making the scheduling process more efficient and productive.

entries.title: Streamlined Approval Process for Project and User Responsibility
entries.description: A new feature has been added to optimize the approval process when using the "Project Responsible + User Responsible" approval type. Previously, if the user's manager and the project manager were the same person, the system required this manager to perform two separate approvals. Now, if the approvers are the same individual, the system requires only one approval, automatically advancing to the next approval level. This enhancement simplifies the approval workflow, reducing redundancy and improving efficiency.

entries.title: Editable Tax Fields on Deliverable Creation in Estimate
entries.description: A bug was fixed that previously prevented the editing of tax values during the creation of deliverables in the estimate. The system only allowed tax value edits after the line was saved. This has been corrected, and now tax fields can be edited during the initial creation of the line.

entries.title: New Description Field Added to Reports Module
entries.description: A new description field has been added to the Reports module. This allows administrators to include detailed descriptions, helping users understand the purpose and context of each report. This enhancement aims to improve clarity and usability, ensuring users can easily comprehend and utilize reports effectively.

entries.title: New User Mention and Assignment Rule Enhances Document Management
entries.description: In the latest release, a new rule has been implemented to enhance the mentioning and assignment of users to documents, aiming to limit access and ensure more targeted user involvement. Only users with the 'plannable' flag enabled are available for selection, ensuring that only relevant users can be mentioned or assigned. This feature improves efficiency by filtering out non-essential users, streamlining the process of document management and collaboration. Administrators can manage this flag, enabling a more controlled and organized workflow.

entries.title: Enhancement to Video Annotations Feature
entries.description:
Introducing several improvements to our video annotations feature, enhancing the overall user experience and collaboration capabilities:

  • Precise Frame Viewing: Users can now view the exact frame where an annotation was made, providing greater context and accuracy to the annotations.
  • View-Only Access to Annotations: Users can access annotations made by other users without being able to edit them. This promotes collaboration and allows for better sharing of insights without compromising the integrity of the annotations.
  • Timeline Bar Access: Users can easily access the timeline bar by clicking on an annotation, facilitating quick navigation to specific points in the video and enhancing usability.

These enhancements aim to make the video annotation feature more robust, intuitive, and collaborative.

entries.title: Expense Copy Functionality
entries.description: We've resolved an issue where copying an expense resulted in incorrect total values, specifically, it caused the value with VAT to be placed in the value without VAT field.

entries.title: New Hour Approval Types
entries.description:
We're introducing additional types of hour approval to offer increased flexibility and granularity in managing time entries:

  • OrderedUserResponsibleAndProjectOwner
  • OrderedUserResponsibleAndClientManager
  • ClientManagerAndOrderedUserResponsible
  • ProjectOwnerAndOrderedUserResponsible
  • OrderedUserResponsible

It's essential to ensure that users have designated responsible parties of the "Timesheet" type in the responsible tab and that the client or company has specified the desired approval type. This setup ensures that the approval process aligns with organizational structures and requirements, facilitating smoother workflows and accurate tracking of time entries.

entries.title: Custom Branding for Different Bindings
entries.description: With this update, users can now define unique branding for different bindings within our platform. Admin Users can now specify distinct branding elements, such as logos, colors, and themes, for each binding. This capability empowers users to maintain brand consistency while catering to different audiences or contexts, ultimately enhancing brand visibility and professionalism across various engagements.

entries.title: Introducing File Sharing Capability Across Documents
entries.description: We are pleased to introduce the addition of file sharing functionality between documents, aimed at enhancing user workflow efficiency. With this update, users can seamlessly copy and paste files without navigating to the final destination document. Simply navigate to the "Files" tab, click on the available "Copy" option under Actions, and select the destination folder for pasting the file. The system will dynamically display a hierarchical view of available folders, ranging from client folders to individual documents and their respective folders, streamlining the file sharing process.

entries.title: Single Purchase Order Generation for Service Discounts in Estimates
entries.description: Previously, when discounts were applied to services in budgets and purchases were made, the system required the generation of two purchase orders to refund the total amount. With this feature update, the system now generates a single purchase order, reflecting the discounted value accurately. This enhancement streamlines procurement processes by eliminating redundancy, ensuring a smoother and more efficient workflow for users.

entries.title: Annotations: Preventing Duplicate Posts When Exiting Preview with Close Button
entries.description: The fix implemented addresses an issue where annotations made on images or videos resulted in duplicate posts when exiting the preview using the close "x" button. With the correction applied, this behavior no longer occurs, ensuring that annotations are not duplicated upon exiting the preview.

entries.title: Adjustments to Budget Calculations based on MarkupwithVat Type
entries.description: We addressed an issue affecting the calculation of negative taxes in the "MarkupwithVat" calculation type within budgets. Previously, when applying a discount to the deliverable, a negative tax was generated, resulting in inaccurate calculations. With the implemented fix, the discounted value with tax is now correctly factored into the calculation, impacting the pre-tax value as expected.

entries.title: Adjustments to Estimate Calculations based on MarkupwithVat Type
entries.description: We addressed an issue affecting the calculation of negative taxes in the "MarkupwithVat" calculation type within budgets. Previously, when applying a discount to the deliverable, a negative tax was generated, resulting in inaccurate calculations. With the implemented fix, the discounted value with tax is now correctly factored into the calculation, impacting the pre-tax value as expected.

entries.title: Enhanced Annotation Feature: Now Supports Annotations on Videos
entries.description: The annotation feature now seamlessly integrates with video content, offering users the capability to annotate videos as they previously could with images. This enhancement expands the utility of annotations, fostering clearer communication and collaboration across multimedia projects.

entries.title: Fix Implemented to Calculate Total Value Automatically Based on Utilization Percentage in Estimates with Defined FTE
entries.description: In estimates with FTE defined, users experienced an issue where the sales value was not automatically calculated when adding resources and initially inputting the utilization percentage. While creating a line and adding hours worked correctly, the system failed to calculate when adding the utilization percentage. This issue has been addressed, ensuring that values are accurately affected when changing the utilization percentage, thereby streamlining the budgeting process and improving user experience.

entries.title: Enhanced Button Functionality with Attention-Grabbing "Action" Type
entries.description: The buttons have been improved by incorporating the "action" type, specifically designed to grab attention. This enhancement significantly enhances user interaction, thereby optimizing the effectiveness of these buttons in attracting attention and eliciting desired responses.

entries.title: Custom Job Types for Commercial Clients
entries.description:
Introducing a new feature enabling the customization of job types for commercial clients within our workspace. This enhancement empowers users to define specific job types tailored to individual clients, providing more nuanced project management capabilities. With this update, users can now effortlessly configure job types for commercial clients, streamlining task creation and offering greater control over project details.

To configure this feature, simply create the desired job types within the configuration settings, and then proceed to associate them in the "Job Types" tab available within the client workspace.

entries.title: Euro Symbol Support Added to Estimate Item Descriptions
entries.description: Recently, an issue was identified where users were unable to add the euro symbol to item descriptions in budgets; upon saving, the symbol would automatically disappear. We're pleased to announce that this problem has been resolved with the introduction of support for characters, including the euro symbol, in budget item descriptions. Now, users can seamlessly include the euro symbol in their item descriptions without any loss upon saving, ensuring accuracy and consistency in budgeting processes.

entries.title: Home Workspace Breadcrumb Access
entries.description: The issue with accessing the home workspace via the breadcrumb link has been addressed. Previously, clicking on the breadcrumb link for a home workspace resulted in an error. The issue has been fixed, ensuring that users can now access the home workspace seamlessly from the upper link without encountering errors. This improvement enhances the overall usability and navigation experience within the system.

entries.title: Addition of Client Contact Field in Projects Document
entries.description: Previously lacking within the Projects document was the ability to include a client contact field, similar to what is available in activities. To address this gap, the same logic present in activities has been applied to the project level. Contacts are created in maintenance, and the visibility of the field can be enabled by adding it in the document member workspace. This enhancement streamlines data management.

entries.title: Invoice Authorization: System Now Maintains Order of Estimate Lines
entries.description: Previously, the system did not consider the order of lines in the estimate when generating an Invoice, resulting in invoices being presented to the client in a different order. To address this issue, the system has been updated to maintain the same order of lines as in the budget when generating the Invoice Authorization. This ensures consistency between the presented estimate and the resulting invoice, enhancing accuracy and client satisfaction.

entries.title: Corrected Export Date in Excel Reports
entries.description: In previous versions, Excel reports exported from the system inaccurately recorded the export date within their content. This issue has been addressed in the current release, ensuring that the export date is now correctly populated. Users can now rely on accurate timestamps within Excel reports, facilitating better tracking and documentation of data exports.

entries.title: Estimates: Decimal Discounts Now Supported for More Precise Definition
entries.description: Previously, users encountered a limitation in defining discounts with decimal values within budgets. The interface has been updated in this release to allow for the specification of discounts with decimal precision. This improvement enables users to define discounts more accurately, accommodating more precise calculations and enhancing flexibility in budget management.

entries.title: Bulk Stage Changes Now Prompt Required Field Completion in Workspace Lists
entries.description: Previously, the system had a limitation in bulk stage changes within workspace lists, particularly when transitions had configured required actions. In such cases, the stage change was not successfully completed. This issue has been resolved. Now, when attempting bulk stage changes, if transitions have required actions configured, a popup will prompt users to provide the necessary information. This ensures that all required fields are completed, allowing the stage transition to be successfully executed. This improvement enhances the usability and reliability of bulk stage changes within workspace lists.

entries.title: Centralized Annotation Updates in Single Feed Post
entries.description: The annotation feature has been improved to streamline user interactions and reduce clutter in the feed. Now, whenever a user creates annotations on multiple images within the same timeframe, all changes will be consolidated into a single post on the feed. This enhancement simplifies the browsing experience for users and ensures that related annotations are easily accessible and organized in one place, promoting efficiency and ease of use within the system.

entries.title: Improved Filtering by Team Members in Job List Workspace
entries.description: A significant enhancement has been introduced to the job list in workspace to improve the functionality of filtering by team columns, enabling more effective filtering of information by specific users. Now, users can easily search and filter jobs based on specific team members, enhancing accuracy and efficiency in viewing job details.

entries.title: Enhanced Validation for Estimate Creation Associated with Jobs
entries.description: An enhancement has been implemented in the budget creation process, particularly when associated with jobs. Previously, the system only validated whether the dates of the created document fell within the period of the parent job. With this update, the validation scope has been expanded to encompass the project or contract period, if applicable. This ensures more comprehensive validation.

entries.title: Expense Integration with Primavera: Order of Submission Now Matches Expense Entry Sequence
entries.description: Previously, the expense submission order to Primavera didn't align with the sequence in which expense lines were entered, making reconciliation challenging. In this release, the expense integration has been updated to ensure that expenses are sent in the same order they were entered. This improvement simplifies the reconciliation process by maintaining consistency between the order of expense entries and their submission to Primavera, facilitating easier tracking and management of expenses.

entries.title: Profile Export and Import Feature Added
entries.description:
A new functionality has been introduced to enable the export and import of profiles. Users with access can now import profiles through the profiles workspace in maintenance, streamlining the process of creating identical profiles and reducing manual effort. This enhancement enhances efficiency and simplifies profile management within the system.

To utilize this feature, users simply need to select the 'Export Role' option followed by 'Import Role.' It's important to note that if a profile with the same name already exists, the child profiles will be updated accordingly. If no profile exists with the same name, a new profile will be created

entries.title: Inclusion of Creation Dates in Expense Lists
entries.description: The expense list within both the menu and the expense sheet now includes the creation dates for each entry. This addition offers users valuable insight into when each expense was created, facilitating more effective tracking and organization of expenses.

entries.title: Integration Error Resolved with VBS Integrator
entries.description: The bug occurred during the commercial client import process, where the import wasn't successfully completed when a client lacked an associated client group filled in. This led to failures in the import process, preventing proper inclusion of clients into the system.

entries.title: Integration of Weekend and Holiday Hours to VBS
entries.description: We've introduced a new feature to enhance the timesheets integration process. Now, hours worked and logged during weekends and holidays will be seamlessly sent to VBS, regardless of the total hours worked on those days. This update eliminates the previous validation requirement of at least 8 hours completed per day for weekends and holidays, ensuring that all relevant data is included in the VBS system for comprehensive analysis and management.

entries.title: Restricting Annotation Modifications to the Creator Only
entries.description: The annotation feature has been enhanced to restrict modifications by users other than the creator. Now, only the original creator of an annotation can edit it, ensuring greater control over the integrity and accuracy of annotations within the system.

entries.title: Effort Field Format Updated to HH:MM
entries.description: Users can now define the format of the effort field to display hours and minutes (HH:MM). Consistency across all system areas is crucial for seamless usability. This support has been added to the Resource Planning Workspace, ensuring that users can set and view effort values in the HH:MM format consistently throughout the system.

entries.title: Mass User Assignment in Jobs Workspace
entries.description: An issue was identified where the mass user assignment feature in the job listing workspace was not correctly validating user access rights. This problem has been resolved, and the system now accurately validates user access rights before assigning them, ensuring that only users with appropriate access to the selected companies are included in the assignment process.

entries.title: Duplicate Display of VAT Field Names in Expense Creation
entries.description: During the creation of expenses, users encountered a bug where the VAT field name appeared duplicated. Investigation revealed that the template formatting of the field was incorrect, leading to this error. The bug has been successfully addressed by rectifying the template formatting, ensuring that users no longer encounter duplicate VAT field names when creating expenses.

entries.title: Bulk Editing in Commercial Clients Workspace
entries.description: The commercial clients workspace now includes a bulk editing feature, enabling users to adjust multiple fields simultaneously for increased efficiency. With this enhancement, users can make bulk changes such as modifying the stage, filling in the sector, assigning managers, updating classifications, and more. This feature streamlines the process of managing commercial clients, empowering users to make comprehensive adjustments across multiple clients with ease and accuracy.

entries.title: Custom Branding Configuration in Environment Workspace
entries.description: With the ability to set multiple bindings for the same environment, the need arose to define different brandings. Now, users can configure distinct branding for each host through the "environment" workspace in the configuration settings. This enhancement provides more granular and flexible customization, allowing different instances of the environment to have their unique visual identity and branding settings, catering to the specific needs of each deployment context.

entries.title: Previous Estimate Versions Unavailable for Viewing
entries.description: Previously, users encountered an issue where accessing previous versions of budgets was unavailable, impeding their ability to navigate between different iterations. However, this problem has been successfully rectified, enabling users to seamlessly navigate and access previous versions of budgets. With this fix in place, users can now effectively track changes, compare versions, and ensure accurate budget management within the system.

entries.title: Client Without Associated Companies Now Returns Users in Project Owner Combo
entries.description: In response to the issue where users were not being returned in the project owner combo when the client lacked associated companies, a bug fix has been implemented. The fix addresses the filtering rule so that when a client has no associated companies, it is treated as having access to all companies. This adjustment ensures that all relevant users, based on the user's access permissions and considering the "Show in accessible Clients only" flag, are included in the project owner combo.

entries.title: Bulk Setting of Timesheet Level for Users in Client Tab
entries.description: In the user workspace, specifically within the client tab, users can now conveniently set the timesheet level for themselves across multiple clients simultaneously. By selecting the desired clients and choosing the "bulk options" feature, users can efficiently define their timesheet level, streamlining the process for managing multiple clients' settings at once.

entries.title: Preventing Reversion of Manually Adjusted Resource Values in Estimates
entries.description:
Previously, when manually adjusting the unit values of resources in the estimate and subsequently making changes to the estimate info (e.g., overhead alteration), the system was reverting the modified values to the base values defined in the ratecards table.

This has been corrected to prevent resetting the values when the budget information is modified.

entries.title: Image Annotation Support Added: Empowering Visual Collaboration
entries.description:
We've introduced the ability for users to add comments directly onto images, enhancing visual collaboration capabilities. With this new feature, users can now annotate images with comments, providing context and feedback directly within the visual content. The annotation history is conveniently accessible within the image preview, allowing users to track changes seamlessly. Additionally, each new annotation generates a post in the feed, ensuring that team members stay informed about updates and facilitating ongoing collaboration.

Enabling this feature requires configuration assistance from the consulting team to ensure seamless integration and optimal functionality.

entries.title: Enhancements to Resource Planning Workspace: Focus on Daily Planning
entries.description: A solution was devised to enhance user efficiency by allowing resources users to mark two lines of resources as validated when they represent the same entity. This was achieved through the addition of parent logic to the Planned Hour Deliverable Total. Additionally, the Split functionality was implemented in the Planned Time workspace, enabling users to right-click a row associated with an Estimate Item Detail and create a copy that serves as a child of the original. Consequently, adjustments made to the child row's days by month now visibly affect the parent totals, facilitating streamlined budget management and user planning processes.

entries.title: Enhanced Project and Contract Owner Selection for Streamlined Workflow Management
entries.description: We've refined the process of selecting project and contract owners to provide users with a more straightforward and secure experience. Previously, users encountered a list of individuals from various agencies when initiating new contracts or projects. Now, we've restricted the dropdown options to align with the user's common access and the client's associated companies, ensuring that only relevant individuals are presented for selection. This enhancement streamlines workflow management, enhances data security, and fosters a more intuitive user experience.

entries.title: Avatars for Clients and Users Without Defined Image
entries.description: We've fixed the avatar bug in the resource module where images were displaying as black instead of showing initials.

entries.title: Introducing Live Updates Property for Kanbans
entries.description: We've introduced the Live Updates property for Kanbans, addressing the need for real-time refreshing of Kanban boards and their associated cards. This new feature eliminates the manual effort required to refresh boards, ensuring that users have instant access to the most up-to-date information. With automatic refreshing enabled, teams can now collaborate more efficiently, make informed decisions, and drive project progress seamlessly.

entries.title: Overwriting of User-Modified Unit Costs in Budget Resources
entries.description: A bug has been addressed where modifications to the unit cost by users in budget resources would be overridden by rate table values if any field in the budget info was subsequently altered.

entries.title: Enhanced User Responsibility Management: Streamlining Approver Updates and Approval Transfers
entries.description: Adjusting a user's responsible directly in the "Responsible" field of the user info would create three new entries in the responsible tab, retaining the previous approver in the list. However, this sometimes resulted in redundant entries, as the previous approver might no longer be relevant. In the updated system, when the responsible is changed directly, the previous approver is replaced by the new one across various levels (leaves, planning, timesheet) in the responsible tab. Approved hours remain visible under the previous approver, while pending approval hours are transferred to the new approver, ensuring smoother transition and more accurate tracking of responsibilities.

entries.title: Enhanced Project Classification
entries.description: In response to the need for streamlined project classification tailored to agency-specific requirements, we've introduced a pivotal enhancement. Now, with the addition of the "Company" field in project classifications, tenants with multiple agencies can enjoy a more refined workflow experience. This update ensures that each agency can view and manage only their relevant project classifications, minimizing confusion and eliminating the need for redundant work.

entries.title: Mandatory Fields in User Creation
entries.description: Introducing a pivotal addition to our software's functionality: the ability for workspace administrators to designate mandatory fields during user creation. With this update, administrators equipped with workspace editing access can effortlessly define which fields are essential for user registration within the parameters settings.This enhancement streamlines the onboarding process by ensuring crucial information is captured upfront.

entries.title: Enhanced Expense Tracking with Addition of Creation Date in Expense List
entries.description: We've introduced a significant enhancement by including the creation date in the expense list. This addition provides users with valuable insights into when each expense was generated, aiding in better expense tracking and management.

entries.title: User Setting for Monthly Expense Sheet Creation Limitation Now Enforced
entries.description: We've addressed a bug where the user setting limiting expense sheet creation to once per month was not being enforced. Now, the issue has been resolved

entries.title: Corrected Error When Attempting to Organize Deliverable Rows in Budgets
entries.description: We've addressed an issue where users encountered errors when attempting to organize budget rows according to their logic. With this bug fix, users can now seamlessly arrange budget lines based on their preferences and specific organizational needs. This correction ensures a smoother user experience, allowing users to efficiently manage their budgets without encountering any hindrances.

entries.title: Bulk Editing in Jobs List Workspace
entries.description: The new feature added to the workspace allows users to perform bulk changes at various levels, offering functionalities such as adding and removing users from teams, as well as editing customizable fields. With an intuitive and user-friendly interface, users can manage these changes efficiently.

entries.title: Improved Responsible Party Sorting in Absence Workspace
entries.description: In the latest update to the Absence Workspace, we've fixed the sorting of responsible parties. This simplifies the analysis of leave statuses and approval stages, making the process clearer and more straightforward for administrators.

entries.title: Added support for Bulk Deletion of Responsibles
entries.description: We're excited to introduce the ability to delete Responsibles in bulk, enhancing administrative capabilities within the workspace. This feature streamlines the process of removing Responsibles across various users, offering greater efficiency and flexibility in user management.

entries.title: Workflow Duplication for Enhanced Efficiency
entries.description: We've introduced the functionality to duplicate workflows within the system, aiming to enhance efficiency in creating new workflows. Now, users have the ability to easily duplicate existing workflows, enabling quick creation of new flows based on established templates. This new feature significantly simplifies the creation process, saving users time and effort. When duplicating a workflow, all settings, steps, and customizations are replicated, ensuring consistency and facilitating the adaptation of existing flows for new projects or needs.

entries.title: Search timesheet fix
entries.description: Previously, jobs without activity for over 30 days were not appearing in search results. This issue has now been corrected.

entries.title: Expense Sheet Export to Excel and PDF
entries.description: In this release, we've addressed a bug related to exporting expense sheets to Excel or PDF formats. The issue has been resolved to ensure a seamless and accurate export process for expense sheets. Users can now confidently export expense data without encountering any issues, improving overall usability and data management.

entries.title: Ability to Configure Parameters in Schedules
entries.description: In this release, we present a solution aimed at improving flexibility and security in multi-tenant environments. Now, it is possible to add custom parameters to schedules, such as AgencyName, ClientName, and Year. These parameters are then passed to the query, allowing for precise data filtering and ensuring that users have access only to information relevant to them.

entries.title: Kanban Board Enhancements
entries.description: In this release, significant improvements have been made to the job Kanban board to enhance user experience and streamline workflows. Now, when card movements involve transitions that require mandatory fields, the system will automatically open a popup for users to fill in the necessary information. This enhancement ensures a smoother and more intuitive process, reducing the likelihood of errors and promoting efficient task management within the Kanban board.

entries.title: Introducing Mass Synchronization for Responsible Users in Leave Management
entries.description: In order to streamline and streamline the synchronization process for users responsible for license management, we propose the addition of a new functionality. Similar to the synchronization option available in the “Responsible” tab, we have implemented the same functionality in the “Subordinates” tab. This improvement will allow HR users to synchronize all users efficiently when someone is added as a new assignee. Currently, the manual sync process for individual users is time-consuming, and introducing this feature will significantly improve the user experience and save valuable time for HR personnel managing large groups of users.

entries.title: Real-Time Document Feed Updates for Added Files
entries.description: Files added directly to the Files tab of documents will now be automatically reflected in the document feed. This improvement aims to keep the entire team informed about the addition of files, including details on who added them. By seamlessly integrating file updates into the document feed, we strive to streamline communication and ensure that the team stays well-informed about the latest contributions. This feature is designed to promote efficiency and collaboration across the board.

entries.title: Integration Upgrade: Syncing Client Groups from VBS to Skills
entries.description: In our ongoing efforts to optimize the integration with VBS, we want to highlight a crucial update. The "Client Group" field from VBS is now integrated into Skills, but it is essential to ensure that the corresponding client groups are created in Skills. This requirement ensures a seamless and error-free integration process, allowing for accurate data transfer between systems. Please verify that the necessary client groups are established in Skills to fully benefit from this enhanced integration feature.

entries.title: Efficient Client Management: Introducing Bulk Actions for Mass Updates
entries.description:
In this latest release, we're excited to introduce a powerful enhancement to the client management system: the addition of a bulk action feature. This feature enables users to perform mass actions efficiently, including the ability to change the status of multiple clients and fill in common information fields such as sector, fiscal year, responsible parties, timesheet levels, and more. The bulk action capability is designed to streamline and expedite the management of client data, providing users with a more efficient and time-saving approach to handling multiple client-related tasks simultaneously.

Bulk actions will be automatically available in the client workspace during maintenance.

entries.title: Project Closure Despite Job Name Field Size Constraints
entries.description: In this release, we've addressed a issue associated with closing projects that was linked to the size limitations of the job name field. The problem stemmed from constraints in the name field size for jobs, impacting the proper closure of related projects. By resolving this issue, we ensure that projects can be closed seamlessly without any hindrance related to the job name field size. This fix aims to enhance the overall functionality and efficiency of project closure processes, providing a smoother experience for users dealing with job-naming considerations.

entries.title: Introducing Favorites for Quick Document and Workspace Access
entries.description:
In this release, we are excited to introduce the concept of favorites in the system, enhancing user customization and document management. Users now have the ability to mark documents as favorites by right-clicking on the document name and selecting the "Mark as Favorite" option. This functionality extends to all documents and workspaces.

  • Mark as Favorite: Users can mark documents and workspaces as favorites for quick and easy access.
  • Favorites Tab in Search: A new "Favorites" tab has been added to the search functionality, allowing users to conveniently access their marked favorites in one centralized location.

This feature aims to improve user efficiency and document organization, providing a user-friendly way to access frequently used documents and workspaces.

entries.title: Efficient User-Department Team Association: Mass Import Feature for Administrators
entries.description:
In response to the need for efficiently updating department teams, we are introducing a new feature accessible through the advanced options in the workspace. This functionality is exclusively available for administrators and allows for a seamless and efficient update using a table/excel format. The import file should include the following columns: User, Company, Division, Department, and Assignment Type.

This enhancement aims to empower administrators with a convenient method for updating department teams on a large scale, providing a user-friendly import process through the workspace's advanced options.

entries.title: Efficient User Monthly Cost Association: Mass Import Feature for Administrators
entries.description:
In response to the need for importing monthly user costs, we are introducing a new feature accessible through the advanced options in the workspace. This functionality is exclusively available for administrators and allows for a seamless and efficient import using a table/excel format. The import file should include the following columns: User Name, Start Date, End Date, Monthly Value, and Hourly Rate.

This enhancement aims to empower administrators with a convenient method for importing monthly user costs on a large scale, providing a user-friendly import process through the workspace's advanced options.

entries.title: Efficient User-Client Association: Mass Import Feature for Administrators
entries.description:
In response to the need for a quick and mass association of users with clients, we are introducing a new feature accessible through the advanced options in the workspace. This functionality is exclusively available for administrators and allows for a seamless and efficient import of data using a table/excel format. The import file should include the following columns: UserName, CommercialClient ExternalId, and Active (denoted as 0/1, true/false, True/False).

This enhancement aims to empower administrators with a convenient method for associating users with clients on a large scale, providing a user-friendly import process through the workspace's advanced options.

entries.title: Efficient User-Company Association: Mass Import Feature for Administrators
entries.description:
In response to the need for a quick and mass association of users with companies, we are introducing a new feature accessible through the advanced options in the workspace. This functionality is exclusively available for administrators and allows for a seamless and efficient import of data using a table/excel format. The import file should include the following columns: Username and Company Name.

This enhancement aims to empower administrators with a convenient method for associating users with companies on a large scale, providing a user-friendly import process through the workspace's advanced options.

entries.title: Description Editor Tools Moved to the Top for Improved Visibility
entries.description:
The formatting tools in the Description field are not always fully visible, causing inconvenience and potential usability issues.

To address this, a new feature has been introduced to enhance the user experience. The editor tools will now be moved to the top of the Description field. This modification ensures that the tools are prominently displayed, improving accessibility and making them consistently visible to users.

entries.title: Introducing New Customizable Workspaces
entries.description:
In this latest release, we are excited to introduce three new workspaces that can be seamlessly integrated into user profiles within production environments. These workspaces, namely "What's New," "Upcoming Events," and "Notes," offer additional functionalities to enhance user experience.

  • What's New Workspace: Showcases the latest features and improvements introduced in each release, providing users with timely updates and insights into system enhancements.
  • Upcoming Events Workspace: Highlights significant company events and user birthdays, serving as a central space for users to stay informed about important dates and celebrations within the organization.
  • Notes Workspace:Functions as a user-friendly notepad, allowing users to make annotations, jot down important information, and store personal notes for easy reference.

It's important to note that these workspaces will not be set as defaults initially. Users interested in incorporating these workspaces into their profiles can request their installation with the assistance of the support team. This addition aims to further customize user experiences, offering more personalized and functional spaces within the system.

entries.title: Improved User Profile Visibility: Introducing 'User Type' Column in the 'Typologies' Tab
entries.description: In response to audit requirements, we have introduced a valuable enhancement to the user profile management system. Users can now efficiently validate all changes related to company, division, department, role, and user type (such as CLT, Freelancer, etc.), along with their respective effective dates. The "Typologies" tab within the user profile already facilitates this process, and we've further streamlined it by adding the user contract type field (Freelance, CLT, etc.) directly within the "Roles" tab.

entries.title: Bug fix for approved projects and associated estimates state
entries.description: In this version, we have addressed a bug related to the state of approved projects and their changes in associated budgets. Previously, when an approved project underwent modifications in budgets, the state was not adequately mapped, resulting in discrepancies. We adjusted the state mapping to accurately reflect changes in budgets and updated the state update flow. This fix aims to provide a more consistent user experience, ensuring that changes in budgets associated with approved projects are accurately reflected.

entries.title: Estimate Numbering Converted to Query
entries.description: With this conversion, estimate numbering has become more flexible, no longer confined to predefined numbering types. Through a query, users can now customize the budget numbering based on the specific needs of the client. This enhancement offers greater adaptability and personalization, providing users with the freedom to tailor budget numbering schemes to align precisely with their unique requirements.

entries.title: Jasmin Integration: Streamlining Financial Document Workflow
entries.description: In this release, we have introduced an enhanced integration with Jasmin, providing a more robust connection for invoices, credit notes, and supplier invoices. Users can now experience a more efficient and comprehensive synchronization between our system and Jasmin, optimizing workflow by enabling seamless integration of essential financial documents. This results in more integrated financial management, reduced manual tasks, and a more accurate, real-time view of business transactions.

entries.title: Workload Updates Based on Document Stage
entries.description:
In this release, we introduce a new feature aimed at improving workload management by considering the document stage. Previously, planned job hours that were canceled still appeared as workloads for users, which was not ideal. With the addition of the "DeleteDailyWorkloads" action, users can now efficiently remove daily workloads associated with a document, particularly in cases like cancellation.

  • Added a new "DeleteDailyWorkloads" action to be used within Workflow Transitions, allowing the removal of daily workloads associated with a document.
  • Add the new "DeleteDailyWorkloads" workflow transition action into the relevant transition, specifically the "Cancel" transition, which is intended to remove the workloads.
  • Verified in the Resources module that daily workloads are no longer displayed after executing the "DeleteDailyWorkloads" action. This ensures that users no longer see unnecessary workloads for canceled jobs, enhancing the overall efficiency of workload management.

entries.title: Enhanced Rate and Price Table Activation Control
entries.description:
In this latest feature update, we've refined the way Rate and Price tables are managed for activation. Previously, the activation status relied solely on the "isActive" flag. With this enhancement, the tables will now take into account the state of the Rate and Price tables, ensuring they are considered active or inactive. Users can now customize workflows to match their unique needs, enhancing adaptability and coherence throughout the platform.

Additionally, to maintain data accuracy, tables in a "closed" or "canceled" state will no longer be available for use in other documents, such as client records and budgets. This ensures that only active and relevant data is accessible for a seamless and accurate workflow management experience.

entries.title: Restricting User Actions until Missing Hours are Recorded
entries.description:
When a user is blocked due to hours missing, they used to be able to open previews of documents in the timesheet grid and add comments. However, with the recent update, if they are blocked, they are unable to perform any actions until all missing hours are entered.

By restricting the blocked user's ability to perform actions in the system until all missing hours are recorded, the feature emphasizes individual responsibility in completing tasks and maintaining the integrity of worked hours records.

entries.title: Timely Integration for Timesheet Updates
entries.description: With this new integration, users can conveniently update their timesheets in Timely, and the recorded hours will seamlessly synchronize with Skills Workflow. The integration facilitates the automatic update of timesheets by removing any existing entries for the same user, project, and day combination, ensuring data accuracy. Moreover, hours added at the project level and user-associated tags (equivalent to work types) provide comprehensive tracking and management of work hours, streamlining the timesheet process for users.

entries.title: Automatic Feed Updates for Parent Document Date Changes
entries.description: The new feature, which automatically adds a post to the parent document's feed when job dates are updated from the child job, represents a significant contribution to efficiency and transparency in project management. By automatically recording changes, it facilitates instant and effective communication among team members, providing a clear trail of events. This not only simplifies the change tracking process but also enhances consistency of information across related jobs, reducing the likelihood of discrepancies in dates. Furthermore, by eliminating the need for manual updates in the feed, this functionality potentially reduces human errors, optimizing workflow and allowing users to focus on more strategic tasks. In summary, the automatic addition of posts to the parent document's feed is a valuable tool for enhancing collaboration and effectiveness in project management.

entries.title: Multiple Bindings per Website
entries.description:
We are excited to introduce the ability to allow more than one binding per website. Starting now, users can enjoy the benefits of implementing multiple sites for the same tenant. This feature is configurable on a per-company basis, providing greater flexibility in tailoring website configurations to specific business needs. This enhancement empowers users with the capability to diversify and optimize their online presence, contributing to a more tailored and efficient web management experience.

This feature should be configured with the assistance of our support team, if needed.

entries.title: Efficient User-Profiles Association: Mass Import Feature for Administrators
entries.description:
In response to the need for a quick and mass association of users with profiles, we are introducing a new feature accessible through the advanced options in the workspace. This functionality is exclusively available for administrators and allows for a seamless and efficient import of data using a table/excel format. The import file should include the following columns: UserName, Roles).

This enhancement aims to empower administrators with a convenient method for associating users with profiles on a large scale, providing a user-friendly import process through the workspace's advanced options.

entries.title: Efficient User-Responsible Association: Mass Import Feature for Administrators
entries.description:
In response to the need for a quick and mass association of users with responsible, we are introducing a new feature accessible through the advanced options in the workspace. This functionality is exclusively available for administrators and allows for a seamless and efficient import of data using a table/excel format. The import file should include the following columns: Subordinate, Responsible, Order and Responsible Type.

This enhancement aims to empower administrators with a convenient method for associating users with responsible on a large scale, providing a user-friendly import process through the workspace's advanced options.

entries.title: Efficient User-Delegates Association: Mass Import Feature for Administrators
entries.description:
In response to the need for a quick and mass association of users with delegators, we are introducing a new feature accessible through the advanced options in the workspace. This functionality is exclusively available for administrators and allows for a seamless and efficient import of data using a table/excel format. The import file should include the following columns: UserName, Delegate, Action (Add or Remove).

This enhancement aims to empower administrators with a convenient method for associating users with delegates on a large scale, providing a user-friendly import process through the workspace's advanced options.

entries.title: Enhanced User Profile Management: Introducing Bulk Timesheet Level Addition in Client List
entries.description: We have introduced significant improvements to user profile management, with a focus on the client list. Users can now take advantage of the bulk functionality to add information en masse at the timesheet level directly from the client list in their profiles. This addition considerably streamlines the process of inputting data in large volumes, providing operational efficiency and time savings. This update aims to enhance the user experience by facilitating the administration of extensive information quickly and effectively.

entries.title: Timesheet Scheduler: Restoring Approver Visibility
entries.description: The bug in the timesheet scheduler where the approver was no longer visible has been resolved. This fix involved reinstating the Approver tooltip and adapting to a database-based storage for the approver information, making it visible exclusively within filled Timesheet cells.

entries.title: Fixed Company Association Issue in Mass User Import
entries.description:
In this update, we've resolved a issue related to the user import functionality. There was a problem where users weren't automatically associated with their respective companies when imported in bulk. This issue resulted in poorly created user profiles, and these users were not accessible in the user workspace.

With this update, we've rectified the user import process. Now, when users are imported using a table, their company information is automatically linked to their user profile within the "company" tab.

entries.title: Enhanced Timesheet Scheduler Performance
entries.description: This release is dedicated to boosting the performance of the Timesheet Scheduler. We've made significant improvements to optimize the scheduling process, resulting in a faster and more responsive experience for users. These enhancements are designed to streamline and improve the overall efficiency of managing timesheets.

entries.title: Performance Improvements in User Assignment to Documents
entries.description: This version focuses on enhancing the performance of the user assignment process to documents. With these improvements, users will experience a more efficient and streamlined process when assigning users to documents. These enhancements have been introduced to optimize the overall user experience.

entries.title: Document Export to Excel
entries.description: We are pleased to announce that we have addressed a bug related to document export to Excel. This issue has been resolved, and you can now export your documents to Excel without any problems.

entries.title: Generic Kanban for Jobs in Project Documents
entries.description:
We're excited to announce a new feature: a Generic Kanban board for managing Jobs within Project documents. This enhancement includes the following key elements:

  • Custom Views: We've introduced customizable views that allow you to tailor the Kanban board to your specific needs. You can define columns, card attributes, and filters, ensuring that the board aligns perfectly with your project management requirements.
  • Document Board Switching: You now have the ability to switch between different Kanban boards within the same document. This flexibility ensures that you can view and manage your Jobs from multiple perspectives without the need for complex workarounds.
  • User-Based Column Locking: To enhance workflow control and user experience, the system will intelligently block document column changes if a user does not have the necessary permissions or if no valid transition is available. This prevents unauthorized actions and promotes smooth, error-free project management.

With these enhancements, our goal is to provide you with a more versatile and user-friendly Kanban board for managing Jobs within your Project documents, ultimately streamlining your project workflow and improving efficiency.

entries.title: Introducing a New Workspace for Organizational Chart Workspace
entries.description:
We've added a new workspace called "Organigram" to help you visually display your teams and departments in a clear hierarchy. Now, you can easily see who leads each team and how departments are structured within your organization, making it simpler to understand and manage your company's structure and responsibilities.

Please note that the Organigram workspace needs to be installed through the Marketplace workspace before access can be granted.

entries.title: Enhanced Timesheets and Absences Workspace
entries.description:
We've upgraded the Timesheets and Absences Workspace with new features. These include extra fields like job type, additional user details, user tags, job position group, project number, employee, project classification, project nature, and client classification. These new fields give you more detailed information when filling out timesheets and tracking absences, making it easier to manage projects, tasks, and your workforce effectively.

Now, you can categorize Timesheets and Absences by job type, specify user details, apply user tags, and group them by job position. You can also link entries to specific projects using project numbers, associate them with employees, and classify projects and clients in more detail. This simplifies your data management, improves reporting, and enhances project and workforce management within your software. Enjoy more control and precision in your operations.

entries.title: Customized Job Progress Visualization in Resource Workspace
entries.description:
We've introduced an enhancement to our Resource Management Workspace. Now, when you view a user's job progress map, you have the option to display the job bars not just from their start dates but from the date of their last stage change to the end date. To activate this feature, simply set the "JobStartDate" parameter to "stagedate." This customization provides you with a more tailored and insightful view of your project timelines based on your specific preferences.

Please note that the Resource workspace needs to be installed through the Marketplace workspace before access can be granted.

entries.title: New Daily Workload Feature in Resource Planning Workspace
entries.description:
We've introduced an addition to our Resource Planning Workspace. Now, you can set daily workloads to specify the number of hours assigned to each project or job and allocate them to individual users on a day-to-day basis. This enhancement provides you with more precise control and flexibility in managing your project resources and schedules.

Please note that the Resource Planning workspace needs to be installed through the Marketplace workspace before access can be granted.

entries.title: New Project Workspace: Project History and Weekly Activity
entries.description:
We are thrilled to introduce a new workspace that offers a comprehensive view of your projects, focusing on their historical progress and weekly activity. This workspace provides valuable insights into project development, including:

  • Project History: You can track the history of each project's stages, including the duration between state changes. This historical data gives you a detailed perspective on how projects evolve over time.
  • Weekly Project Creation: The workspace displays the total number of projects created each week, allowing you to monitor project initiation trends and workload distribution over time.
  • Project Classification Analysis: You can view graphs and charts categorizing projects based on their classifications, helping you identify patterns and trends within different project types.
  • Pivot Table: You can analyze projects based on various criteria, providing a flexible and interactive way to investigate your project data.
  • Final Project List: Easily access a comprehensive list of all your projects, making it simple to review and query specific project details.

This new workspace is designed to enhance your project management capabilities by providing valuable historical data, visual representations, and exploration tools, ensuring you have the insights needed to make informed decisions and optimize your project workflows.

entries.title: Enhancements in Integration with VBS System
entries.description:
We're excited to share some significant improvements in our integration with the external VBS system:

Within the Skills timesheet grid, hours that have already been imported will now display in the tooltip, accompanied by their external ID number. This added visibility ensures you can easily track your integrated hours.

Going forward, only hours that have been submitted for approval will be transmitted to the VBS system.

Now, only the hours and absences for a user's current day will be sent if the total hours meet the minimum required. This ensures that data sent to VBS aligns with your organization's policies, optimizing efficiency and accuracy in the integration process.

In the event of an integration error, users will receive notifications within their timesheets, allowing them to promptly address any discrepancies. These notifications will inform users that their hours were not correctly updated in the VBS system, ensuring transparency and accountability.

entries.title: Enhanced Leaves My Department Workspace
entries.description:
Previously, the dashboard displayed data without accounting for holidays and did not consider the user's company. With this update, Leaves My Department will now provide a more comprehensive view by showing both user absences and holidays specific to their company. We have added the user's company information to the displayed holidays, ensuring that the workspace reflects a more accurate and tailored representation of leave and holiday data within the organization.

Please note that the Resource Planning workspace needs to be installed through the Marketplace workspace before access can be granted.

entries.title: Advanced Workload Management: Setting Workloads by Day and Period in Resource Scheduler Workspace
entries.description:
In our Resource Scheduler Workspace, we've introduced an advanced feature that allows you to set workloads not only on a daily basis but also over specified periods. Now, you can define workload assignments by specifying start and end dates, and the system will evenly distribute the workload across the designated days within that timeframe. This addition provides you with even more flexibility in managing and optimizing your project resources efficiently.

Please note that the Resource Scheduler workspace needs to be installed through the Marketplace workspace before access can be granted.

entries.title: New Integration with Jasmin Financial System
entries.description:
We are excited to introduce a new integration with the Jasmin financial system, aimed at streamlining various financial processes:

  • Invoice Integration: Now, authorizations for invoices created within the Skills Workflow will be seamlessly sent to Jasmin. This ensures efficient management of billing authorizations, improving your financial workflow.
  • Service Creation: You can now create articles and services directly within Jasmin, simplifying the process.
  • Client and Supplier Management: Commercial client records, as well as supplier records, will be automatically created in Jasmin, reducing manual data entry. On our end, we will populate billing client and supplier tables with the necessary information.
  • Currency, Payment Conditions, and Tax Configuration: To facilitate seamless transactions, we'll ensure that currency, payment conditions, and tax tables are synchronized between the two systems. This ensures consistency and accuracy in your financial data.

With this integration, you'll experience improved efficiency, reduced manual data entry, and enhanced financial control as your systems seamlessly communicate with Jasmin for various financial operations.

entries.title: Enhancements in Omie Financial System Integration
entries.description:
When invoices are generated in Omie, the Skills system now receives the invoice number in the invoice.

This synchronization ensures seamless integration between both systems.

entries.title: Enhancements in Real-Time Service
entries.description: We're excited to announce improvements to our Real-Time service! Now, when two or more users are simultaneously editing the same document, the system will alert you about conflicting updates and give you the option to either keep your changes or update the document. If you choose to update, the document will refresh, incorporating the changes made by the other user. This allows you to add your input to the latest version. If you opt not to update, your changes will be saved under the previous version, preserving the alterations made by the other user in the previous description. These enhancements ensure a smoother collaborative editing experience, preventing conflicts and preserving your work.

entries.title: Enhancement: Inclusion of 'Detail' field in Timesheet Reports
entries.description: We have incorporated a improvement to our Timesheet Reports. Now, administrative personnel can access and view the detailed information entered in the 'Detail' section of the timesheet. This enhancement ensures that the 'Detail' information is seamlessly integrated into the "Timesheet Permisos y Vacaciones" report, providing administrators with comprehensive insights into timesheet-related data.

entries.title: Timesheet Approvals with Hierarchical Structure
entries.description:
We've introduced an enhanced approval process for timesheets in the system.

Previously, you could designate either the project owner, client manager, or the user responsible for approving a user's timesheet. Now, similar to the existing leave approval process, you have the flexibility to define a hierarchical approval structure for hours.

To implement this, you need to specify the approver type as "Ordered User Responsible" or "Project Owner And Ordered User Responsible" and sequentially assign responsible individuals in the 'Responsibles' tab within the user workspace, categorizing them under the "timesheets" type. The functionality mirrors that of leave approvals, where hours become available for the next approver in line once the previous one has granted approval.

This enhancement streamlines and customizes your timesheet approval process, offering greater flexibility and control.

entries.title: Brief Templates for Requests
entries.description: We are excited to introduce a powerful enhancement to the Request document - the integration of Brief Templates. Similar to how templates can be associated with jobs and projects, you can now configure templates for your briefings and link them to specific types. To get started, simply create the necessary templates in the configuration settings and associate them with the relevant document types. Once this is done, whenever you create a brief with these types, the template will be automatically added to the document description. This feature streamlines the briefing process, ensuring consistency and efficiency in your documentation.

entries.title: Enhanced Work Type Differentiation in Timesheets: Introducing Flags for Administrative and Client Tasks
entries.description:
In this update, a new feature has been introduced to differentiate between administrative and client work types in timesheets.

To provide a more refined work type selection experience in timesheets, the following changes have been made based on the "Is Client" and "Is Administrative" flags:

  • Client Work Types: Work types flagged as "Is Client" will now be presented in the "Work Types" column within the timesheet grid. This ensures a clear representation of work type associations for allocated hours.
  • Administrative Work Types: Work types marked as "Is Administrative" will now be available for selection in the suggestions popup within the timesheet, specifically within the "Administrative Hours" tab.

entries.title: Importing User Leaves from BambooHR to Skills Workflow
entries.description: In this update, a new feature has been introduced that enables the seamless import of user leaves from the BambooHR system into the Skills Workflow platform.

entries.title: Importing User from BambooHR to Skills Workflow
entries.description: In this update, a new feature has been introduced that enables the seamless import of user from the BambooHR system into the Skills Workflow platform.

entries.title: Addition of New Properties in BambooHR Integration
entries.description:
In this update, new properties have been added to the integration with BambooHR.

  • Email in SSO and AD Username Fields: The integration now allows the email address to be automatically populated into both the Single Sign-On (SSO) and Active Directory (AD) Username fields. This simplifies user access and ensures consistency across systems.
  • Minimum Daily and Weekly Hours: In response to user feedback, the integration now populates the minimum daily and weekly hours based on the predefined values set by the company. This automation reduces data entry and aligns with company-wide standards.
  • Default Profile Assignment: The default profile assignment streamlines user onboarding and ensures proper profile alignment.

entries.title: Fixed Expense editing Issue
entries.description:
In this update, we have addressed an issue related to editing expenses that were automatically generated through the duplication of an expense sheet.

Previously, when an expense sheet was copied, including its associated expenses, users were encountering difficulties in making edits to the copied expenses.

We have resolved this issue to allow users to make the required edits to expenses that have been generated through the duplication of an expense sheet. With this correction, users can now freely modify the details of copied expenses as needed.

entries.title: Importing Commercial Clients from Skills Workflow to Timely
entries.description: In this update, a new feature has been introduced that enables the seamless import of Commercial Clients from the Skills Workflow platform into the Timely system.

entries.title: Importing Projects from Skills Workflow to Timely
entries.description: In this update, a new feature has been introduced that enables the seamless import of projects from the Skills Workflow platform into the Timely system.

entries.title: Daily Resource Allocation in Staff Plan Workspace
entries.description:
We are excited to introduce a significant enhancement to our Staff Plan workspace in the Builder module. Now, users have the capability to create plans using days as the unit of measurement, providing a more flexible and accurate resource planning experience.

Traditionally, our system has focused on planning resources in hours. However, we understand that many projects require a day-based approach for more precise resource allocation.

To address this need, we have expanded the capabilities of our Staff Plan workspace. With this new feature, you can now create plans in days, ensuring that your resource allocation is aligned with project timelines and account management requirements.


Please note that the Staff Plan workspace needs to be installed through the Marketplace workspace before access can be granted.

entries.title: Introducing a New Workspace for Planning Time in Days
entries.description:
We are pleased to introduce a new workspace dedicated to planned time, which is designed to enhance your resource allocation process. This addition addresses the need for more flexible resource planning, as we recognize that planning in days is just as crucial as planning in hours.

entries.title: Improvements to the Kanban per Period workspace

  • Select Desired Tags: A dropdown list will display all available user tags. Choose one or more tags that you wish to filter by.
  • See the Results: Once the filters are applied, the task list will be automatically updated to display only those tasks that correspond to the selected user tags.

Please note that the Kanban per Period workspace needs to be installed through the Marketplace workspace before access can be granted.
