entries.title: Configuration to define Teams to be copied in job duplication
entries.description:
This feature allows users to indicate which teams should be copied during the duplication of jobs. This enhancement improves efficiency and eliminates unnecessary work in manually editing teams during job duplication.

If no configuration is made, the default behavior should be to copy the teams as they are during the job duplication process.

entries.title: Mass Leave Assignment in Hours
entries.description:
This feature will allow administrators to assign "mass leaves" hours simultaneously to all users in a company or to a selected group. This functionality will simplify the process of marking collective absences in the company calendar, ensuring that all users have their absences properly recorded.

The feature will be accessible only to administrators or users with specific permissions.

Administrators will be able to select a specific date or a period of time during which they want to assign the "mass leave". It will be possible to select all users in the company or only a specific group of users to apply the collective absence. Instead of assigning whole days off, administrators will be able to specify the duration of the absence in hours. The system will automatically calculate the total hours of assigned absence and reflect them in the individual records of the users.

Users will be able to view the absence along with other scheduled absences.

Benefits:

  • Facilitates the assignment of collective absences for all users in a company, saving time and administrative effort.
  • Avoids the need to manually mark each individual leave separately.
  • Ensures that all users have the same amount of assigned hours off, maintaining fairness and transparency.

entries.title: Job Profitability Workspace
entries.description:
The Job Profitability Workspace is a new feature that has been created to provide a dedicated workspace for tracking and analyzing the profitability of individual jobs. This workspace offers valuable insights into the financial performance of jobs, enabling users to make informed decisions and optimize their business operations.

Please note that the Job Profitability workspace needs to be installed through the Marketplace workspace before access can be granted.

entries.title: Typology Group Import
entries.description:
The Typology Group Import feature allows users with administrative access or typology group access to import groups of typologies within the maintenance area. This feature simplifies the deployment processes for new clients and the configuration of new companies added to existing sites.

Importing typology group must be done in Excel format, directly in the typology group workspace of the configuration.

The required column structure for the import file as follows:

  • Name: The name of the typology group.
  • Company: The associated company for the typology group.
  • Order: The order in which the typology group should be displayed (optional).
  • Active: A flag indicating whether the typology group is active or not.

entries.title: Report duplication
entries.description:
The report duplication feature enables users to create copies of existing reports within the same environment. It is accessible through the maintenance area and the reports workspace. Only users with report creation access have permission to use this feature. It allows for the quick creation of reports with minor differences.

Duplication Process:

  • When a user selects a report to duplicate, create a copy of the report, including all associated configurations, filters, and visualizations.
  • Allow the user to modify specific details of the duplicated report, such as the report name, description, or filter settings.
  • The duplicated report is saved separately from the original report, with a unique identifier.

entries.title: Holiday Import Functionality
entries.description:
The holiday import feature is designed to streamline the maintenance and deployment of environments that involve multiple companies. By providing a convenient way to import holidays, this feature aims to improve the accuracy and efficiency of managing holidays across different environments.

Importing holidays must be done in Excel format, directly in the Holidays workspace of the configuration.

The required column structure for the import file as follows:

  • Name: The name of the holiday.
  • Company: The company associated with the holiday.
  • Date: The date of the holiday.
  • Description: Additional information or details about the holiday (optional).
  • Allow timesheets: A flag indicating whether timesheets are allowed on this holiday.

entries.title: Time Sheet Approvals and Missing Time Workspace
entries.description:
This workspace is designed for team managers. Its purpose is to help you manage timesheets, track approvals, and identify missing time entries from your subordinates.

It is organized into different sections.

  • The "Pending Users and Pending Hours" section provides you with general information about the total number of missing time entries from your team. It shows how many users have not submitted their timesheets and the total number of hours pending.
  • The "Blocked and Pending Users" section provides detailed information about the users who have not submitted their timesheets and the reasons for their blocks. This section helps you understand why certain users are unable to submit their entries and take appropriate actions.
  • The "Locks and Unlocks History" section allows you to analyze the behavior of each user over time. You can identify individuals who consistently fill out their timesheets and those who do not.

By using this workspace, you can effectively manage timesheets, ensure timely submissions, and gain insights into user behavior.

To use this workspace, you need to install it through the Marketplace workspace first. Once installed, you can access the timesheets area to begin using its features.

entries.title: Client FTE Workspace
entries.description:
The objective of this workspace is to provide a comprehensive financial management solution for tracking data related to clients, hours, and sales values within each fee arrangement.

To provide a more detailed analysis, the information can be filtered by date and segmented by department and positions.

Sections:

Total Contracted Hours: This section displays a column showing the total number of hours contracted for each client. It provides an overview of the agreed-upon hours for billing purposes.

Actual Hours: This section provides a breakdown of the actual hours worked for each client. It is further divided into the following sub-sections:

a. Billable Hours: This sub-section displays the number of hours worked that can be billed to the client. These are the hours directly related to client projects or services.

b. Non-Billable Hours: This sub-section shows the number of hours worked that cannot be billed to the client. These hours may include internal meetings, training, or non-client-related tasks.

c. Administrative Hours: This sub-section showcases the number of hours spent on administrative tasks such as project management, invoicing, or client communication that is not directly billable to the client.

The workspace allows for easy tracking and monitoring of hours and values associated with each client's fee arrangement. It provides insights into the distribution of hours among billable, non-billable, and administrative categories, aiding in financial analysis and decision-making.

Please note that the Client FTE workspace needs to be installed through the Marketplace workspace before access can be granted.

entries.description: To analyze the cost of estimates, a new field was added to the list: Total Cost without tax.

entries.title: Added a field in the Files micro service to add Comments.
entries.description:
Added a field called Descrition to let the User add information about the File.

This feature was added only on the file system V3.

entries.title: Created a user FTE Workspace.
entries.description:
Created a standard FTE for Users:


Parameter - Added a parameter to set the FTE value;

Contracted - Show Contracted time where Users are shown;

Actuals - Show the Actual time per Client, Billable and Administrative;

Filter - Added a range selection for the dates selection.

entries.title: Added the Time Sheet Level to the Client User in Configuration.
entries.description: In order to assign a Time Sheet Level to the user, a new field has been made available in the Users association workspace in the Client.

entries.title: Created Workspace for All Projects in Contracts.
entries.description: A new workspace has been created, where you can view all projects associated with contracts.

entries.title: Created an Entire List for Jobs.
entries.description: A new list of all jobs was created, with existing fields but in workspace version.

entries.title: Created an automation to create documents between tenants automatically.
entries.description:
Created an Automation attached to a Webhook (with a shared secret) that sends Jobs to another Tenant.

  • Projects - Import only Jobs for Projects that are mapped;
  • Jobs - When a Job is created or updated, it is sent to the destination Tenant;
  • Number - Set the destination Job Number to the same as the source Number;
  • Comments - Add Comments from the source Tenants in the corresponding Jobs in the destination Tenant;
  • Teams - Set the Teams in the destination Tenant to the same in the source Tenant;
  • Workflow - When a Stage changes, it is sent the destination Job to the same Stage as the source Tenant.

entries.title: Integration with ADP - Added the External ID to the user when it is inactivated.
entries.description:
When the user is deactivated in ADP, the integration will now add the external number to your user name in Skills Workflow.

This way, if the user needs to be recreated, the system no longer demonstrates a mismatch in the equality of the user name.

entries.title: Created a List of Projects as a Workspace
entries.description:
Created a list of projects as a workspace.

This workspace contains fields such as:

  • Priority - Represented by colors: Red, Green and Blue;
  • Owner - Grouped by Owner and represented by the user's Avatar;
  • Media type
  • Comment - With the possibility of inline editing;
  • Overdue - Where you can see overdue dates in red.

entries.title: Adjusted the UX in the Timeline view of Absences Approval.
entries.description:
Workspace improvements:

  • Added the Current User to the filter;
  • Added a quick filter to see only the Users that are under the Responsibility of a User;
  • Added option in Context menu for Approval (Single | Batch) and Rejection (Single | Batch);
  • Added the popup for the Reasons for Leaves Rejection.

entries.title: Added the possibility of multiple groupings in custom views lists
entries.description: The user can now organize his views, taking advantage of multiple groupings, in order to facilitate the analysis of results.

entries.title: VBS: Added the TimesheetGroupByProject setting.
entries.description:
Added a TimesheetGroupByProject setting.

  • If TimesheetGroupByProject and TimesheetGroupByClient are active, the hours are grouped by project.

entries.title: Added Workspaces Roles on Marketplace and Workspaces.
entries.description: When using the Marketplace or Workspaces workspace, there is a column named "Roles" and that it presents the roles designated for that workspace.

entries.title: Added option to Export and Import Document Configuration into Marketplace.
entries.description:
Added logic to import and export workspaces configuration.

This way we can transfer settings between tenants quickly.

entries.title: Created a new Closed Estimates workspace
entries.description:
New Closed Budgets workspace:

  • User can see all estimates in Done and Closed Stage Types State.

entries.title: Added Product tab to Client Workspace.
entries.description: Added Product tab to the Client Workspace. Now the user is able to create products directly under the client.

entries.title: The importing and exporting workflow transitions considers the "Query Validation" field.
entries.description:
There is a new field in Workflow transitions that is "Validation Query Name" to control what can and cannot be done in this stage change.

This field is now included in the export/import workflow process, so these validations are not lost.

entries.title: Added additional Parameters to the Builder Workspace.
entries.description:
Added the following parameters for Estimate QuantityCap:

  • DeliverableQuantityCap - Quantity cap applied to the deliverables section.
  • ServiceQuantityCap - Quantity cap applied to the services section.
  • ServiceWithTemplateQuantityCap - Quantity cap applied to services with Tasks template associated.
  • ExpenseQuantityCap - Quantity cap applied to the expenses section.
  • TimeRateQuantityCap - Quantity cap applied to the Time Rates section.

entries.title: Added Vendor Tax information in Purchase Orders.
entries.description:
Added Vendor Tax information in Purchase Orders.

  • This field is coming from the services table in the Sub-Estimate builder.

entries.title: Added bulk support, to perform state changes for different workflows simultaneously.
entries.description: When updating jobs through bulk with different workflows and types, if the transition exists, the bulk already performs the state change, ignoring the fact that the type or workflow is different.

entries.title: Added setting to define the time of day to detected Blocked User.
entries.description:
Added Assistant Blocking Time to the Configuration.

  • This will behave as the alert time configuration, as it will only run the timesheet blocking for that certain hour.

entries.title: Adjusted the UI on the Custom Views options.
entries.description:
Inserted views button (filter symbol) with the following actions:

  • Delete (symbol X)
  • New view (plus symbol)
  • Duplicate (duplicate symbol)
  • Edit (change the switch name from Default to Public)

entries.title: Added a default company when creating a Commercial Client.
entries.description: When creating a new Commercial Client, the User's Company will now be added by default to the Companies tab inside the Client.

entries.title: Changed the Custom Views service to record the Roles that will have access to them.
entries.description:
Public Custom Views now support role association.

  • In this way, it is possible to create views and make them available only for some profiles.

entries.title: Added Bulk to the Suppliers workspace.
entries.description: In order to make the system more efficient, the Bulk option was added to the Suppliers workspace. In this way it is possible to update the VAT field simultaneously in more than one supplier

entries.title: Target document lock when executing actions.
entries.description:
In order of long-running actions, we cannot allow the target document to change during processing, new properties have been added to the interface:

  • FullDocumentLocked;
  • LockedBy;
  • LockedOnUtc.


If the user tries to modify the target document, during the process of performing actions, the system shows an error message.

entries.title: Added support for three types of views (default, public and personal).
entries.description:
Added support for different types of Views:

  • Standard - Stored in the Marketplace along with the Workspace;
  • Private - Stored in the micro service;
  • Public - Stored in the micro service.

entries.title: The timesheet closing period now considers the company's Timezone.
entries.description:
The timesheet closing period now considers the company's Timezone.

In this way, the system considers the local 00H:00M, of the defined day, so that the days are blocked.

entries.title: Adjusted the Unit Total with tax when the calculation type is Markup.
entries.description:
With this type of calculation, users when creating estimates can immediately see the unit value with the tax values.

In this way, the unit price column is calculated as follows:

  • Unit value with tax = Total sale value with tax / quantity

entries.title: Added support to upload Files in the creation Workspace.
entries.description: Added Files widget to have the possibility to upload files in the job creation.

entries.title: Created a timeline Workspace for Leaves approval.
entries.description:
Created a timeline Workspace for Leaves approval:

Used the Scheduler to show a full year.

Added filters for:

  • Department
  • Users
  • Projects
  • Company
  • Responsible

Added approval options in the Context Menu.

entries.title: Created Workspace to show Time Sheet in Contract.
entries.description:
Created Workspace to show Time Sheet in Contract.

In this way it is possible to visualize a summary of the hours allocated to the contract, distributed by the different documents.

entries.title: Added the Currency and Exchange Columns in the Estimate Quotes for Services.
entries.description:
Added the Currency and Exchange Columns in the Estimate Quotes for Services.

  • Added both columns (hidden by default) editable.
  • When the Supplier is changed, set the Currency in the Supplier and the Exchange from the Currency.

entries.title: Purchase Orders are now created in the currency defined in the Estimate Third Party Service Supplier.
entries.description:
When a user is creating Purchase Orders:

  • The Purchase Order currency and exchange is inherited from the Estimate Third Party Service Supplier.


In this way, it is possible for the Client to generate Purchase Orders in local currency linked to a estimation in foreign currency.

entries.title: Added support to import and export a Workflow from a json.
entries.description: Through the transitions workspace, it is available to import workflows via the import table.

entries.title: Created a list with Estimate Deliverables.
entries.description:
Created an Estimate Deliverable list to consolidate the information between estimates and deliverables.

This list will support the data cross to FTE.


Based on All estimates, the following fields have been added:

  • Deliverable Name
  • Deliverable Start Date
  • Deliverable End Date
  • Deliverable Total Hours
  • Deliverable Sell Value

entries.title: Created a new FTE by user workspace.
entries.description:
Created an FTE by user where the client field is not taken in consideration.

With this option we will be able to show as well the detail by user.

entries.title: Added select box to select executor in job creation form in Board workspaces.
entries.description: When creating tasks directly in the Boards workspace, a checkbox is available to assign an executor directly in the popup.

entries.title: Added synchronization of assignments and descriptions with Active Collab.
entries.description:
Synchronization of assignments and descriptions with Active Collab:


  • Teams - When a User is added to the Team in Active Collab, the team is synced
  • Description - When the Description changes in Active Collab, the description is synced

entries.title: Added Contract and Project  name and code to the Profitability Workspace.
entries.description: In order for the user to be able to identify the contract associated with the Project, the project and contract columns were added separately to the Profitability workspace.

entries.title: Added option to delete lines inside expense builder.
entries.description: Activated the X button when selecting lines within an expense, so that the user can delete lines without having to cancel the expense sheet.

entries.title: Added a quantity cap in the builder
entries.description:
Added 'quantityCap' property to validate that all of the Builder quantities cannot exceed that value.

This option is a parameter that allows the maintenance users to adjust the cap if necessary.

entries.title: Added option to hide certain transitions from document feed.
entries.description:
Created a custom function to handle the Transitions to show:


Stages - Removed the Transitions from all Workspaces when showing to the User.

Configuration - Added a Custom Function to list the Transitions to remove.


This feature was developed to be used in conjunction with the BATCH functionality. This way, users will not be able to move documents when they have a batch active, through documents feed or others workspaces.

entries.title: Created an integration with Totvs.
entries.description: User should be able to use Totvs Workspace to link documents between Api Sei and Skills Workflow.  Once this Document is linked with a Supplier Invoice or with an Expense on a stage change to "To Integrated" an automation update the invoice in Api SEI.

entries.title: Reordered the order of replies in Feed posts.
entries.description:
Reordered the order of replies in Feed posts.

  • Currently the answers are shown following a chronological order.
  • Answers are now being sorted from top to bottom.

entries.title: Created a test to check the Job's performance when assigning users
entries.description: In order to verify the performance of a Job's when the user assign users, a test with K6 script was created.

entries.title: Adjusted the CustomViewNaviaget role.
entries.description: The CustomViewNaviagate role now controls access to the list views menu. In this way, users without CustomView Navigate permission cannot access the existing menu options.

entries.title: Created a test to check the Job's performance when the user update additional fields
entries.description: In order to verify the performance of a Job's when the user update additional fields, a test with K6 script was created.

entries.title: Created a test to check the Job's performance when the user add hours.
entries.description: In order to verify the performance of a Job's comment, a test with K6 script was created.

entries.title: Added a List of Client Contracts to the Client.
entries.description: In order to analyze the contracts at the Client level, a new Contracts workspace was created within the Client document.

entries.title: Seted the Invoice number in the field NODOC.
entries.description: Placed the external number of the supplier's Invoice in the NODOC field.

entries.title: Added Margin and Negotiation columns to the Deliverables section.
entries.description:
Estimates

  • Added Margin and Negotiation columns to the Deliverables section.
  • This represents the Margin (and Negotiation) total of the respective details.

entries.title: Added the Priority field to the Request Document.
entries.description:
Added the Priority field to the Request Document:

  • In the document info, the user can assign a priority to the document.

entries.title: Builder take into account the round values from Estimate currency.
entries.description: Builder take into account the round values from Estimate currency.

entries.title: Added option to upload files in the creation form for Tenders document.
entries.description: Added option to upload files in the creation form for tenders as it works for other documents.

entries.title: Added Quantity concept in the action that creates the Jobs from the Services.
entries.description: The Query to create tasks from job type returns quantity, in order to create multiple jobs.

entries.title: When creating Briefs, Jobs, Sub-Jobs, and Tasks only shows sprints that belong to the Project.
entries.description: When creating Briefs, Jobs, Sub-Jobs, and Tasks Only shows sprints that belong to the Project.

entries.title: Added support to download the Files from the Creation forms.
entries.description: Added support to download the Files from the Creation Form: All files available for the selected Type should be made available.

entries.title: Created an universal configuration for the numeration in the Document.
entries.description:
Added support on Tender and Job to can format number by data source:

  • Added on DocumentNumberQuery on document type and business object type.

entries.title: Added support to import Workflow Stages.
entries.description: Added support to import Workflow Stages via configuration import table.

entries.title: Upgrade DevExtreme version.
entries.description:
Upgrade DevExtreme version:

  • Upgrade the widgets to the latest version.

entries.title: Added support to import worktypes.
entries.description: Added support to import worktypes via configuration import table.

entries.title: Added support to disabled default buttons in workspace's properties.
entries.description: Now it is possible to disabled default buttons in workspace's properties.

entries.title: Added missing fields on the All Estimate List Workspace.
entries.description:
Added missing fields on the All estimate list:

  • Type
  • Contract
  • Created by
  • Modified On
  • Modified By

entries.title: Adjusted ADP integrator for username field.
entries.description: When creating a user:  Name - Set the name to the username instead of the full name. Changes - When the user exists, do not change this field.

entries.title: Created a new method of calculation in the Estimate: MarkupOnlyOnVAT.
entries.description: The new calculation is done as follows:  Calculation First - Calculate Commission in the default way: Commission x Sell Next - Calculate Markup on VAT only: First / (1 - VAT%) - First Finally - Sum: First + Next

entries.title: Global Planning Workspace: Included the list of Clients in a column.
entries.description: The payment map now has the associated Clients column available in each PO line.

entries.title: Global Planning - Added tasks without executor.
entries.description: Show Unassigned Tasks:  Unassigned - Add the Deliverables with no Executor to the list Total - Show the total Deliverables in the Executors chart

entries.title: Added Requests documents in the Kanban.
entries.description: Changed the Data Source to include Briefs in the Kanban Workspace.

entries.title: Added columns to the Tender lists.
entries.description:
The following columns are added in All, mine, closed, my pending actions lists:


a) Columns shown in list view by default:

  • Code
  • Title
  • Status
  • Due date
  • Currency


b) b) Columns that are part of the column selector:

  • Version
  • Created by
  • Created on
  • Modified By
  • Modified on.

entries.title: Added an option to dissolve the Batch.
entries.description: If users start a new batch and at any point need to move one particular task to "hold" they need to dissolve the batch. This means that once the batch is created it moves together either to complete or back to ready.  Provided a “Dissolve Batch” button. The dissolve batch button is remain inactive if no task is selected.

entries.title: Created the "Info" tab for Tenders document.
entries.description: Created the Info tab for Tenders:  Sections - Added an Info and a History sections.

entries.title: Created Roles for the Custom Views.
entries.description: New role "PublicViewSave" is created in the system and it is possible to attribute this role to the User. This role allows the user to create public views.

entries.title: Added support to switch a view from Public to Personal and vice-versa.
entries.description: Added support to switch a view from Public to Personal and vice-versa.

entries.title: The RequestUserField action has been adjusted to request only the fields marked in the transition.
entries.description: It is possible to define, in the first transition of the workflow, which fields must be filled in by the user when activating the document.

entries.title: Added the possibility to upload files in document templates through the new File System
entries.description: In document creation, it is available for back office users to associate files with document creation templates. In this way, the common user at the time of creating the document has access to this previously attached file.

entries.title: Added a setting in the, to let the User change Leaves that have been sent for approval.
entries.description: Added "Can Delete Approved Leaves" setting in the Company. In the Leaves scheduler, one can now delete approved leaves with this setting turned on.

entries.title: Applied live updates to the Kanban boards.
entries.description: The boards currently have live updates. If a user is working in the workspace, and another user changes information in a job, this update is done in real time. In this way, the user can view all the changes that are made simultaneously.

entries.title: Created a Workspace for the Estimate to show the Estimate Reconciliation.
entries.description: Added a Reconciliation workspace to the Estimate; Same structure of the builder, with Deliverables, Services, Expenses and Time Rates grids; Each row has a comparison between the Original and Actual values for the given Service/Typology/Expense, with an additional Difference column, color coded to better represent financial losses; Also the Notes custom field column was added, being the only editable field (save button available); Although only the most recent and original columns are shown by default, if an estimate has more intermediate versions, they can still be viewed through the column chooser, if needed.

entries.title: Added 'BlockTemplate' user field to the Service.
entries.description: There are multiple third-party lines auto-populated in the builder. These are mapped to populate "sub-job / task" column of the builder. Some of these should not be editable, while others should not be editable.  If the flag is enabled, it will disable the editing of the Sub-Job/ Task Template field in the Services grid, according to the chosen Service.

entries.title: Created Feed, History and Files tabs for Tenders.
entries.description: Tenders is a new module in the system. Like the other modules tenders include the following tabs in workspace version: Feed, History. They also include a tab Files as per other documents.

entries.title: Added the button to navigate to the Tenders from the Preview popups.
entries.description: Added the button to navigate to the Tenders from the Preview popups.

entries.title: Added Rejected By/On information both in the "My Absence" list and in the Leave detail popup.
entries.description: Users need to be able to see when and who rejected the leaves. Both approved/rejected On and By are now available in the popup so that when the user is adjusting the leave they can have this information.

entries.title: Added a way to create Numbering based on a Data Source.
entries.description: Instead of having many variations of numbering methods, added a Data Source as a parameter to determine the way the Numbers are generated. In this way, the numbering format is more flexible and adjustable to the needs of each client.

entries.title: Billing Workspace: Extended the data rage selector to the full year.
entries.description: Extended the data rage selector to the full year.

entries.title: Added Live update to document name.
entries.description: The name in the header of the documents is now updating in real time. That is, if a user modifies it, other users will not need to refresh to see this modification.

entries.title: Added support to replace tabs in the Client.
entries.description: Now its possible to hide the tabs in documents. Hide - Let the User hide the tabs no longer needed Tabs - Added support to show new tabs from Workspaces.

entries.title: Added support to chage the Product field in the tender.
entries.description: As in the other documents, it is possible to edit and associate products with Tenders.

entries.title: Added the Gridster "Layout" properties to the Workspace setup.
entries.description: Some Workspaces (e.g., lists) only intend to use the full screen space.  Now exist a way to set the Workspace to occupy only the available screen space on any resolution.

entries.title: Added dates to the Dynamics Integration workspace.
entries.description: Added the days in the captions of the week days.

entries.title: Made the group typology field editable on the user.
entries.description: A user's division, department, and typology group change over time If there is a need to adjust the existing table, to make it easier it is now possible to search by typology group.

entries.title: Created a new Configuration Workspace 'User last login'
entries.description: Through this workspace, it is possible to validate the date of the last login of each user in the system.

entries.title: Added support for multiple Workflows in Requests, based on Business Object Type and Type.
entries.description: Briefs (requests) document now supports different workflow based on Type like the other documents.

entries.title: Added ability to use multiple rate cards in estimation
entries.description:
A lot of times some services are not available in the Client agreed rate cards, or sometimes they service does exist in the client rate card but they want to use a different rate.


For this motive:

  • Added a search icon in the Service/Typology Group lookups in the Builder.
  • Added 2 new popup Workspaces (Builder Rate Cards and Builder Price Tables).


This will allow the User to modify the existing rate for the Service/Typology Group. A popup will appear with the available rates (taking into account the Company, Client and Currency of the Estimate).

entries.title: Adjusted the Primavera interface for the column missing in Primavera 9/10:  "TipoFor".
entries.description: Fixed triggers to update taxarea.

entries.title: Created roles to control access to custom views.
entries.description:
Custom Views have roles defined. These roles control endpoint operations like any other object.

  • CustomViewNavigate
  • CustomViewCreate
  • CustomViewSave
  • CustomViewRead
  • CustomViewWrite

entries.title: Reach: Update the minimum daily hours and timesheet required fields in SW when a user is created or updated in Reach
entries.description: When a new user is created or updated, the "Minimum Daily Hours" field gets automatically populated in Skills Workflow according to the user type of each user.

entries.title: User Typologies are now editable and the lookups work in cascading
entries.description: Made the fields editable to facilitate the selection of the Typology by the User: Company, Division and Department, and the lookups work in cascading.

entries.title: Added ability to edit expense fields directly in the grid without having to open popup
entries.description: To improve efficiency in the process of creating and editing expenses, the user can now perform these actions directly inline.

entries.title: Applied Custom Views to Resources.
entries.description: Applied Custom Views to Resources. To enable this option, you must go to enable the flag in the workspace settings.

entries.title: Added the Year as a filter to the Margins Workspace.
entries.description: Added the Year as a filter to the Margins Workspace:  Year - Filtered by the date of the Bill, when there is no Bill, filtered the year of the date of the Document.

entries.title: Adjustments in the import of Invoices from Saphety.
entries.description:
When importing Supplier Invoices from Saphety:


  • Entry Date - It is the date of import
  • Purchase Order - Changed the field being used to determine the Purchase Order Number
  • Invoice - Set the document as processed to avoid processing it again
  • Value - Corrects the value when they are different

entries.title: Added the Year as a filter to the Margins Workspace.
entries.description: Added the Year as a filter to the Margins Workspace:  Year - Filtered by the date of the Bill, when there is no Bill, filtered the year of the date of the Document.

entries.title: Added real-time updates in the resource workspace.
entries.description: Added real-time updates in the resource workspace. Now changes made by another user will be automatically reflected in my Resources without refreshing.

entries.title: Added Roles to support to Custom Tables.
entries.description:
Custom Tables values read and save are now controlled by roles.

These are defined in the custom tables configuration - default is Administrator.

entries.title: Created 4 Tenders lists in the side menu bar
entries.description:
Created 4 new Tenders lists in the side menu bar:


1) My Pending Actions - Tenders where I've been assigned as the Assignee (executor team)

2) Mine - All Tenders where I have been assigned as part of any given team

3) All - All active Tenders for clients I have access to regardless of assignment

4) Closed - Tenders in cancelled and done stages.

entries.title: Added support for Tenders in the File System.
entries.description: The new file system is ready to create the root folders for this document type. This means that it's possible to add any files or links on this document type.

entries.title: Improved saving times for Documents Comments and Descriptions.
entries.description: The document recording infrastructure was redone, in order to improve performance.

entries.title: Added a button to turn Edit Mode on/off in the Custom View.
entries.description: Added a button to turn Edit Mode on/off in the Custom View. - With this button turned on, the user is able to edit his own view.

entries.title: Added inline expense description editing.
entries.description: The expense builder, in workspace format, is available for editing the description and adding inline files.

entries.title: Created Jobs Statistics Workspace.
entries.description: Job statistics workspace created: The purpose is to make available to the user the numbers of jobs created in the system, filtered by a period of time, and the following facts: customer, company, department, type and user. Metrics - Number of jobs Dimensions - Month Facts - Customer, Company, Department, User, Type.

entries.title: Created Automations to sync Tasks with Active Collab.
entries.description: When a task is created in Skills Workflow, a comment is added to the equivalent active collaboration task with a link to the Skills Workflow Job.

entries.title: Added sorting by "created On" when creating Expense Items.
entries.description: When creating expenses, they will be organized by creation date.

entries.title: Automatically import VAT from Expense Types via Primavera to Skills Workflow.
entries.description: When importing Primavera Expense Types, the system automatically updates the VAT rate in Skills Workflow.

entries.title: Added ability to create versions of the Estimate builder workspace.
entries.description:
Added the navigation between Versions to the Estimate:

  • Version - The same approach as the regular Estimates
  • Readonly - The previous Versions are readonly

entries.title: Adjusted calendar colors when block type is weekly.
entries.description: When the block type is weekly, the calendar until the week is filled with the minimum weekly hours, shows the week as incomplete.

entries.title: Added the possibility to define vacation entitlement in hours.
entries.description:
• Renamed Leaves/Holidays actions in Users list to 'Assign' instead of 'Manage';
  • The 'Assign Leave Types' now supports adding hours for Leave Type with the hours setting enabled (the ones with it turned off will only be able to add Days as it was previously implemented);
  • The 'Assign Leave Types' now only supports one Leave Type at a time, to avoid confusion regarding how many days are being added.

entries.title: Added Role support in list definition.
entries.description: Added support to edit the Roles of the List Definitions in Configuration.

entries.title: Improvements to the Search Workspace.
entries.description: Some improvements have been made to the workspace layout. - It is possible to group and filter the results list.

entries.title: Added confirmation message when user navigates away from description.
entries.description: To prevent the user from losing all changes after typing the description of a document, when navigating, a confirmation message was added.

entries.title: Created a standard format in Excel to import a Budget Forecast.
entries.description: Added a Parameter to specify if the standard format is to be used:  Workspace - Added a parameter to specify if the standard format is to be used: UseStandardFormat.

entries.title: Added highlight to current day in system calendars.
entries.description: The current day is now marked with a border, in order to guide the user.

entries.title: Created Workspace of system usage.
entries.description: Created a Workspace that shows global system count of documents.

entries.title: Added the possibility to define typologies and Monthly cost by periods.
entries.description: Through this configuration, it is possible to save the history of these values, in a table, in order to allow analysis of real data.

entries.title: Created an Automation to handle incoming Users from Dash.
entries.description: The current integration allows mapping users between Skillsworkflow and Dash, based on the external user id.

entries.title: Added the possibility of auto populate worktype for tasks based on type.
entries.description: Added association between work type and job type. The Feed and Timesheet suggestions now attempt to automatically fill the Work Type based on what's defined in the Job Type (this only works for Jobs).

entries.title: Created an action to create SubJobs based on a flag in the Third Party entries in the Estimate.
entries.description: Added a flag on the Deliverables section to define whether the underneath sub-jobs/tasks will be created based on the Estimate items.  If flag is on it means that the sub-jobs/tasks should be created from the estimate line items. If flag is off, it will created the sub-jobs/tasks not from the estimate but from the job template.

entries.title: Added ability to link jobs/sub-jobs/tasks with each other in the info tab of jobs, sub-jobs and tasks in a field called "Linked tickets".

entries.title: Added the possibility to sort by dates when using the search engine.

entries.title: Added actions to created automatic teams to the Supplier Invoices.

entries.title: The search popup turned configurable .

entries.title: Created a Workspace for the Backlog in Mobile
entries.description: Users, through the mobile app, will have access to consult the Backlog workspace.

entries.title: Added button on the kanban item to change stage.

entries.title: Added support for configuring the help button at the top of the page.

entries.title: Added auto refresh to the All Jobs list with Search

entries.title: Added  new fields to the UserLookup

entries.title: Added totals to Ageings and show only Supplier and Client.

entries.title: Added selected custom view indicator to workspace subtitle

entries.title: Added interface to import suppliers via VBS.
entries.description: Added interface to import suppliers via VBS.

entries.title: Created a new workspace called Projects Pipeline.

entries.title: Added the Estimate Currency to the Profitability Workspace.

entries.title: Added the Company Currency to the Profitability Workspace.

entries.title: Added the Project Owner to the Margins Workspace.
entries.description: The user will be able to analyze the profitability of the projects, with the possibility of filtering documents based on those responsible for each project.

entries.title: Created an automatism between Skills and ActiveCollab.

entries.title: VAT became editable in Financial workspaces.
entries.description: VAT, which was previously auto-populated and fixed, became editable in the financial workspaces: Bills / Purchase Orders / Client Credit Notes / Supplier Invoice and Supplier Note. In this way, the user has as suggested the one defined in the back-office, but he can always modify it.

entries.title: Effort is now automatically calculated in the Planning workspace.
entries.description: The effort in the grids is now calculated using the start and end date of the job. Considering a full day with 8 hours, the effort is calculated based on the difference between the last and the first day of the task.

entries.title: Added column with paid value in the Bills and Credit Notes lists.
entries.description: Added column with paid value in the Bills and Credit Notes lists.

entries.title: Added a flag in the Stage to indicate if it supports time entry.
entries.description: A new setting has been created to prevent users from putting timesheets on documents with certain stages of the workflow.

entries.title: Added support for real-time updates to the jobs list.
entries.description: When someone changes a document that a user is looking at in the list, the list will be updated.

entries.title: Added the ability to massively assign holidays to users.
entries.description: Through the users workspace, the maintenance user now has access to a new bulk action: Manage Holidays. In this way it is possible to massively assign holidays to several users simultaneously.

entries.title: Added support for files in the My Absences workspace.
entries.description: The new file system has been added to the leaves workspace so that the user can attach documents.

entries.title: Added bulk support on the new All Jobs List.
entries.description: The user, through the new list of jobs, already has the bulk operation available.

entries.title: Added additional fields on Leave Types workspace.
entries.description: Added the following fields to the Leave Type: Company - Added the possibility to define leaves types by company. If the field is not filled in, the company's configuration prevails. Description - Text box to provide more info for the leave type. IsPlannable - Setting that allows the leave type to be reflected in the resource module.

entries.title: Added additional fields on Holidays workspace.
entries.description: Company - Added the possibility to define holidays by company. If the field is not filled in, the company configuration prevails. Description - Text box to provide more info for the leave type. IsPlannable - Setting that allows the leave type to be reflected in the resource module. Time Sheet - Added the AllowsTimeSheet flag to determine if it support Time Sheet entry Tags - Add support for tags.

entries.title: Added the option to invoice by value.
entries.description: The system allows the user to invoice in two ways. The "Amount type" field was released, where the user must indicate whether he intends to invoice in % or in value. After this selection, the user is able to define the respective values.

entries.title: Added way to differentiate automatic Time Sheets from manuals in the Scheduler.
entries.description: In the Time Sheets calendar, it is possible to differentiate the hours that were filled automatically, through the workflow action. Cells of this type have a different border.

entries.title: Added support for user to delete files in Leaves.
entries.description: Through the new filesystem, the user is now able to add files and delete them.

entries.title: Added new fields to the leave type workspace list.
entries.description: Added all the missing fields to the Leave Types workspace column chooser: Company ; Description ; RequiresAttachments ; IsPlannable.

entries.title: Added the option to set the limit on the Bulk.
entries.description: In order not to compromise the Software's performance, a new setting was created that allows users to be limited to 25 objects simultaneously.

entries.title: Added the ability to assign holidays by user.
entries.description: Added a flag to the User to select which Holidays the User will have. This way, the user can enjoy holidays that are not part of their main company.

entries.title: Added support for filtering, grouping and sorting custom fields on the All jobs' list.
entries.description: Added support for filtering, grouping and sorting custom fields on the All jobs' list.

entries.title: Added holiday description in the tooltip.

entries.title: Added modified on, modified by, created on, created by in Suppliers workspace.
entries.description: New fields have been added to the supplier workspace in order to see who created a new supplier or who modified an existing supplier and when.

entries.title: Created a new automation, which makes it possible to configure the body of the sent email.

entries.title: Created a Workspace to show the logs of EAS.
entries.description: Through this workspace, the user can easily check the integration logs between Skills and EAS, detecting possible errors that may exist.

entries.title: Added a new predefined filter to the document lists.
entries.description: Through the new button added, the user is able to create predefined filters in their listings. For now it is only available on the All Jobs list.

entries.title: Added a popup with a Filter Builder to build a filter with grid fields.
entries.description: New Filter features were implemented: - Builder: opens a popup with a Filter Builder to build a filter with grid fields. When saving, apply the filter to the grid. - Clear: clears all filters applied to the grid. - Save: is only displayed if a filter is selected. Saves all changes made in filtering the grid. - Save as: creates a new filter based on a selected filter or the filter that is selected in the grid. - Delete: is only displayed if a filter is selected. Removes the selected filter.

entries.title: Added option to hide inactive workspaces from menu.
entries.description: Through the Skills menu, the user only has access to consult the workspaces that have the active's flag turned on. If an admin user needs to activate the workspace, he must do so through the workspace "Workspaces" in maintenance

entries.title: Created Supplier Ageing Workspace.
entries.description: Through this workspace, users are aware of what is to be received and when from their suppliers.

entries.title: Created a Client Ageing Workspace.
entries.description: Through this workspace, users are aware of what is to be received and when from their Clients..

entries.title: Added the possibility to duplicate Forecasts versions.
entries.description: The Users need to create simulations of alternative predictions (forecasts) of the Company's performance, through this feature your work becomes faster.

entries.title: Added formulas to the budget workspaces.
entries.description: In order to facilitate the users' work, a matrix with formulas and the accounts that need them was added to the forecast workspace. In this way, the value of the columns is calculated based on the previously defined matrix.

entries.title: Added the "Allow All Job Types" flag to the Types list in Configuration.
entries.description: Through the list of the "Types" workspace, it is possible to check which types have the active/inactive flag, without having to navigate in each one.

entries.title: Added support for exporting products to VBS.
entries.description: Added support for exporting and updating products to VBS.

entries.title: The "Minimum Daily Hours" field was considered in the integration with Reach.
entries.description: According to the type of user, when a new user is created or updated in Reach, the "Minimum Daily Hours" field is automatically filled.

entries.title: Added a filter for the Responsible to the Time Sheet Workspace in the Project.
entries.description: In order for project managers to be able to view the hours allocated to the projects they are responsible for, there is now available a new workspace "Consulting Hours of Responsible Projects".

entries.title: Added typology and user typology group integration with HR Link
entries.description: Skills Workflow are able to get the Typology and the Typology Group from HRLink:  Typology - If it is a new Typology, create it and associate to the Typology Group Typology Group - If the Typology Group does not exist, create it Names - Use the names in the file.

entries.title: Added division and department to the margins workspace.
entries.description: The user can consult the estimate division and department through the margins workspace.

entries.title: Added a setting in the Company to specify if Time Sheet is constrained to the Document Start and End.
entries.description: A new setting has been made available in the company.  When turned on, the system will not verify if the Timesheet is within the document dates.

entries.title: Added user approved or approved by hr leaves in the Boards Workspaces.
entries.description: Responsible users, through the Boards Workspace, are able to consult the future leaves of their subordinates, in order to be able to plan activities ensuring the availability of users.

entries.title: In the People on Leave workspace, the leaves approved by HR were added.
entries.description: In the People on Leave workspace, the leaves approved by HR were added. All leaves now appear except "Unapproved"

entries.title: Adjusted the Action "UpdateProjectAssignments" to go through Teams, associated to the Project.
entries.description: The action UpdateProjectAssignments now merges the Assignments coming from Jobs, Estimates, Bills and Credit Notes into the parent Project; This action also can now be set into the workflow of one of the aforementioned documents (previously it could only be used in Jobs).

entries.title: Added Estimate number to the Profitability Workspace.
entries.description: For better data interpretation and analysis, the estimate field has been added to the profitability workspace.

entries.title: Added the possibility to schedule more than one leave in the same day, through the Workspace "My Absence".
entries.description: Users shouldn't be able to book 2 full leaves in the same day using different leave types. However if users are scheduling half day, they are able to book 2 halfdays using different leave types.

entries.title: Added the possibility to make changes in the state of individual leaves throught the "My Absences" Workspace..
entries.description: The My Absence workspace now makes use of the Request Approval by Leave Id instead of the Leave Type Id, which did not allow for the user to request approval for a single row.

entries.title: Converted Expense Creation Form into a Workspace.
entries.description:
Created a new workspace for expense Creation with the following fields:

  • Title
  • Type
  • Expense Type
  • Company
  • Finance Job Number (custom field)
  • Currency
  • Cash Advance Request number (custom field)

entries.title: Created support to add shifts to Users.
entries.description: Today there is a place in the system to assign shifts to employees. The goal is for a booker to be able to tell (in the resource scheduler) who is available to pick up a certain task based on the shift each person is working.

entries.title: Created a new Leaves Scheduler workspace called "My Absense".
entries.description:
A new Leaves workspace is now available, with the following features:


  • Year - Show a filter to select the Year
  • Types - Show a Tile View with the Leave Types the User has
  • Calendar - Show a calendar of 12 months with the scheduled Leaves
  • List - Show a list of the User Leaves
  • Switch - Let the User switch between the list and the Leave calendar
  • Create - Add a popup to create a Leave from a Leave Type

entries.title: Added the Audit of Reservations to the list.
entries.description: Added the Reservations to the historic changes in the Resources allocation. This history provides a log of all events happening with a reservation in the scheduler. This will help trace the steps and analyse the root cause.

entries.title: Created a new Leaves Approval workspace called "My Approvals".
entries.description:
A new Leaves workspace is now available, with the following features:


  • Added basic functionality for the Leave Approval;
  • Grid with the periods available for the user to approve;
  • Status filter in the grid;
  • Year date box;
  • Calendar switch to enable showing a calendar view of the same information represented in the grid.

entries.title: Created a new workspace for Assets & Orders into a Request document.
entries.description: Created a new workspace for Assets & Orders for clients that don't have a DAM integration. It is similar to the existing Assets & Orders but whithout the Master Assets part - only with the Orders table.  Added ability to create orders by clicking on a plus sign.

entries.title: Added some new fields to the Expense types workspace.
entries.description:
Added the following fields to the Expense types workspace:

  • Type
  • Modified By
  • Modified On
  • Created By
  • Created On

entries.title: Stage Mapping Changes in Feed are now posted by Skillio Name.
entries.description: Added the RealCreatedBy to the Documents:  Changes - When changes are performed, set the Created By to the internal user Real - Always record the Real Created By in the Document for future reference.

entries.title: Added a Data Source to the Document Assignment Type.
entries.description: It is possible, through a query, to define which results are desirable in the lookup for Users per Team. Example: only agencies that have been working with determinate client must appear in the drop down list.

entries.title: Modified Message displayed about mandatory fields when a document is moved out of draft status
entries.description: Added the message field so that it can produce a customizable message from the filled in data.

entries.title: Added Shifts to Configuration.
entries.description:
A new concept was created in the system: the ability to configure shift schedules by company.

There are multiple people across different companies who work in shifts, so it was created a new shifts workspace.


The fields required for this configuration are as follows:

  • Company
  • Name
  • Start Time UTC
  • End Time UTC
  • Created By
  • Created On
  • Modified By
  • Modified On
  • Active

entries.title: Added the option to add tags in a User in Configuration.

entries.title: Automatically set the drop boxes width and filter in Grids.
entries.description:
Automatically set the drop boxes width and filter in Grids.


These 2 UX features are now standard, to avoid having code in the Workspaces: Lookup columns, should fit the items text, to prevent the text from being cut.

entries.title: Changed the grid to use the setColumns after an edition.
entries.description: When saving a change in the Grid through the context menu, if it is configured with Columns, the system remove it from the configurations and leave only the setColumns.

entries.title: Added support for group count in the search queries.
entries.description: The fields in the search index are set up so that you can get the count for each distinct value.

entries.title: Added option to navigate between versions of a Budget.
entries.description:
There are new functionalities in the Forecast and Actuals Workspaces inside the Budget:

  • It is now possible to import data directly into the Forecast workspace and Actual.
  • In the Forecast workspace it is possible to navigate between versions, and rename them.

entries.title: Added support to recover sessions in any Browser window
entries.description:
The login is valid for 24 hours and is renewed automatically to avoid having to login every day.


Token - Now the token renewal is read from the browser and not the page (for the case when it is already renewed in another tab). The system, only takes the User to the login if the token is no longer valid.

entries.title: Added the possibility to import Budget from the spreadsheet.
entries.description:
Added the possibility to import Budget from the spreadsheet.

entries.title: Added the possibility to choose the predefined formatting when editing a total.

entries.title: Added option to integrate leaves with VBS
entries.description: The leave and leave type fields now have an external id, so they can be sent to VBS. The behavior is identical to that of the Timesheet, when the leave is exported, the system keeps its id to guarantee future updates on them.

entries.title: Fields related to timesheets in the user form are inherited from the company.
entries.description: When new users are created, the default values of the 'minimum and maximum hours' fields will be set according to what is defined in the company. When users are created via importer, the behavior is the same.

entries.title: Added leave duration in resource module.
entries.description: If a user has a leave in hour marked, the manager, through the resources module, can see the number of hours that the user will be absent.

entries.title: Added Export button to the Rates and Price Tables grids.

entries.title: Added a filter by department in board workspaces.
entries.description:
Added department filter in the unassigned grid in boards workspaces.

entries.title: Added user company accesses control in the Planning, Purchase Orders and Supplier Invoices workspaces
entries.description: Through the Planning, Purchase Orders and Supplier Invoices users can consult financial information about the companies they have access to.

entries.title: Added user company accesses control in the Team Leaves workspaces.

entries.title: Add the Department to the Expenses list inside the Expense Sheet
entries.description: Added Department column in the Expense Items list inside the Expense

entries.title: Expense: VAT field is filtered by expense company
entries.description: In the expense, the VAT field is filtered by the VATs defined in the expense company.

entries.title: Duplication of expense lines
entries.description: It is possible to duplicate expense lines. The fields, such as the supplier, must all be copied.

entries.title: View contracts through the Profitability workspace
entries.description: It is possible to open the preview of contracts directly from the Profitability workspace.

entries.title: When market is changed manually, the Service rates update values
entries.description: When the Market and Language fields are changed in the builder it is automatically assume the values for the new changes

entries.title: Draft documents are being activated without mandatory fields
entries.description: It is possible to define, through a query validation in the workflow transition, which are the mandatory field to conclude the action.

entries.title: Auto generate thirdparty service lines, when user selects the Service in deliverable line
entries.description: In the estimates, it is possible to configure for the deliverables lines are auto generated.

entries.title: Block checklist Items in checklist master ingestion when Master Job is in Approve or Approve with warnings
entries.description: A new flag is available, which allows blocking the checklist when master documents are in certain states

entries.title: Swapping or promoting a reservation into a task
entries.description:
The feature allows users to swap or promote a reservation into a task.

The "Convert to task" option is available in the context menu.

entries.title: The Checklist from MI jobs does not inherit the parent's description
entries.description: Checklist Items should be created with description in blank.

entries.title: Assignee and Job-sub job owner are being showed up in Master ingestion checklist
entries.description: In project document, Master ingestion checklist tab it is possible to see who is the assignee and job/sub job owner of the checklist jobs.

entries.title: Blocked documents not allow document changes from Kanban board
entries.description: When a document is blocked, it does not allow for Workflow, Team and Info changes.Blocked documents not allow document changes from Kanban board

entries.title: Gantt: Allow to Copy and Paste drafts documents
entries.description: It is possible, through the gantt, to copy and paste documents in draft status

entries.title: Provide a log book of all events happening with a task in the scheduler
Gantt Improvements: When executing a transition with repeated final states, the gantt already records the changes
entries.description: In Gantt, there is a column called STAGE Stage column is the name of the status where the document can go to In some cases, the drop-down shows multiple transitions to move to the same status

entries.title: Added support to add buttons to rows through the context menu, in the grid.
entries.description: Added support to add buttons to rows through the context menu, in the grid.

entries.title: More options to format the colors of Grid columns
entries.description:
The system have diferents formations options to the Cell:


  • Fixed - What is the background color of the cell.
  • Calculated - What is the calculation formula.
  • Array - The editor must be a grid with colors and formulas to be applied to the cell's background color.
  • Bold - You have to be able to indicate that the cell text is bold.

entries.title: Estimate List - Column Modified By does not return information
entries.description: In the list of estimates, the ModifiedBy field is filled with the name of the last user to make adjustments to the estimate.

entries.title: Set permissions for the grid context menu to be displayed
entries.description: The grid context menu is now taking into account the user permission. Only shows up if user has access to "DashboardWrite".

entries.title: In the VBS integration, the Time Sheet is now exported
entries.description:
Every day, the Time Sheet, that has been changed since the last export, is sent to VBS.

This includes New and Approved Time Sheet.
